### BoK Gate check (v3 — MCORCH Master Execution Protocol)

For each BoK suite in `docs/bok/<slug>/`, verify completeness:
```bash
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete" || echo "⚠️ $slug — missing: ${missing[*]}"
done
```

If the user mentions working on a **new module / complex feature / integration / architectural change**:
- Check whether `docs/bok/<expected-slug>/` exists with all 9 docs.
- If missing: surface in the **ALERTAS** section as a critical block per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.
- Recommend `/bok-scribe <idea summary>` before any code is written.

## Rules

- **TypeScript errors → report immediately.** If there are TS errors, list them under ALERTAS. Do not start implementing new features until errors are resolved (unless the user explicitly asks to proceed despite errors).
- **Unhealthy containers → report with triage.** Suggest the fix command if known (e.g., `docker compose restart mcorch-vector-engine` for chroma).
- **Uncommitted changes → describe, do not commit.** Only describe what exists in the working tree; committing is the user's call.
- **Keep the brief tight.** No padding. No repetition of CLAUDE.md architecture. The user already knows the architecture — they need the delta: what changed, what's broken, what's next.
- **Pending Actions priority order:** CRITICAL (before first client) > NON-CRITICAL > Phase Zeta > Core v3 > Epsilon v9.
- **Knowledge Mesh numbers:** use `GraphRAG State` section from HANDOFF.md as the source. Do not invent counts.

> 165	## Sprint v5.9.0 — FMEA-005 + LGPD Deploy Record (2026-05-08)
> 166	
> 167	Sessão de fechamento do último FMEA crítico e validação do deploy LGPD em produção. O alertas do handson identificaram duas pendências: as Edge Functions `data-export` e `delete-account` e a migration `20260508025933_delete_account_rpc.sql` estavam implementadas localmente mas não confirmadas em produção; e FMEA-005 (RPN 144) tinha apenas mitigação parcial (head+tail truncation naive que descartava o conteúdo do meio de nós grandes). A verification `npx supabase db push` confirmou que a migration já estava aplicada remotamente; o deploy das Edge Functions confirmou as funções LGPD em produção — Phase Commercial está operacionalmente desbloqueada. Para FMEA-005: a função `embed-mcorch-node` foi reescrita para dividir o conteúdo em chunks de ≤ 20.000 chars em fronteiras semânticas (blank lines), enviar todos os chunks como batch input ao OpenRouter API (suportado pelo `text-embedding-3-small`), receber N vetores 768d, calcular a média aritmética e armazenar o vetor médio em `mcorch_nodes.embedding` — sem mudança de schema. Nós com conteúdo < 20.000 chars seguem o mesmo code path (chunks = 1) sem overhead. O response agora inclui `chunks:N` para observabilidade. `scratch/` vazio foi removido. Contagem real de nós: 7280.

> 183	### Arquitetura — FMEA-005 Chunked Embedding
> 184	
> 185	```
> 186	embed-mcorch-node (atualizado):
> 187	  rawContent → splitChunks(CHUNK_CHARS=20_000)
> 188	    split at \n\n boundaries within window
> 189	    chunk[0]: "[name]\n\n[content_start]"
> 190	    chunk[1..N]: "[content_continuation]"
> 191	  OpenRouter batch API: input = string[]
> 192	    → data[0].embedding  (768d)
> 193	    → data[1].embedding  (768d)
> 194	    → ...
> 195	  averageVectors(chunkVectors) → single 768d vector
> 196	  UPDATE mcorch_nodes SET embedding = <avg_vector>
> 197	  Response: { node_id, dims: 768, chunks: N, model }
> 198	```

> 202	## Sprint v5.8.0 — FMEA + BoK Phase 2 + 8-Agent System + LGPD Record (2026-05-08)
> 203	
> 204	Sessão de fechamento de cinco grandes iniciativas em sequência: dois FMEA críticos, enriquecimento estratégico da BoK Suite, geração do sistema de 8 agentes, e compliance LGPD. FMEA-008 (RPN 120): a função `orchestrate-content` recebia conteúdo do LLM e inseria diretamente em `content_library` sem qualquer validação — artigos truncados, posts LinkedIn de 3 palavras e threads de 1 tweet chegavam ao WordPress e às redes. A correção adiciona `validateContent()` com thresholds por tipo (article: 500, linkedin: 50, twitter_thread: 30) imediatamente após a geração de cada tipo, zerando `articleContent` na falha para bloquear o step WordPress, e emitindo erro estruturado via `addStep`. FMEA-011 (RPN 100): 47 migrations sem review gate — uma tabela nova sem RLS poderia vazar dados entre tenants. A correção é processual: checklist obrigatório Fase 4b no skill `/migration` com 5 itens (RLS, default-deny, PII, `/security-review`, sem secrets hardcoded) e entrada em `CLAUDE.md` como padrão de código não-negociável. Phase 2 BoK Enrichment adicionou a "voz estratégica" que o reverse-engineering não consegue capturar: Sovereign's Conviction (por que MCORCH existe), Business Philosophy (5 não-negociáveis + north-star M3 retention), Por Que Vencemos (4 moats compounding), Validação com Criadores (3 observações compostas PT-BR), Architectural Decisions (5 decisões com rationale de lock-in), e Quality Philosophy (por que 98% é o alvo correto no estágio atual). `/bok-agents-generator` foi invocado contra o BoK enriquecido e gerou `bok-agents-system--mcorch-constellation.md` (704 linhas): 8 agentes (BABOK/EABOK/DMBOK/BPM-CBOK/SWEBOK/CISSP-CBK/CXBOK/ProdBOK), cada um com 10 seções, adaptados ao contexto Creator Economy SaaS B2B2C AI-native, mais 3 camadas cross-agent. LGPD: `delete_account()` SECURITY DEFINER RPC com cascade DELETE em 9 tabelas em ordem de dependência retorna audit summary JSON; Edge Function `delete-account` chama o RPC + `auth.admin.deleteUser()` via service role, com log antes da deleção; `data-export` coleta 7 tabelas PII e retorna JSON estruturado com `Content-Disposition: attachment`; SettingsPage ganha card "Dados & Privacidade (LGPD)" com modal de confirmação gatekeado por digitação "DELETE". Phase Commercial desbloqueada.

> 89	## 🧭 3. PRODUCT PRINCIPLES
> 90	
> 91	These are non-negotiable. Every PM/eng/design decision is evaluated against them.
> 92	
> 93	1. **Autonomic by Default** — every feature must implement at least one of: self-configuration, self-healing, self-optimization, self-protection. Manual modes are exceptions, not defaults.
> 94	
> 95	2. **Monetization is Mandatory** — every piece of content generated must have a monetization vector (affiliate link, ads CTA, sponsorship slot, or organic conversion goal). No "art for art's sake" outputs.
> 96	
> 97	3. **Zero-Trust Frontend** — no sensitive logic, no API keys, no business rules in the client. All execution flows through Edge Functions with RLS default-deny.
> 98	
> 99	4. **Knowledge Graph First** — every entity (content, trend, link, campaign, asset) must be a node in the GraphRAG. Context drift is the enemy.
> 100	
> 101	5. **Speed Over Polish (Until P1 Quality Gate)** — ship at Speed of Thought. Polish at the quality gate, not before.
> 102	
> 103	6. **One Workflow, Infinite Reuse** — every workflow must be saveable as a Recipe. Manual repetition above 3 times is a bug.
> 104	
> 105	7. **Cost-Aware AI Routing** — heavy creative tasks use premium models. Background/scoring tasks use free-tier (Groq). Cost transparency in every operation.
> 106	
> 107	8. **Sovereignty Always** — Oracle Cloud + Docker + self-hosted n8n. No vendor lock-in for critical infrastructure.
> 108	
> 109	9. **Brazilian Portuguese First, English Native** — primary language for users is pt-BR. Internal logs, code, and architecture are en-US.
> 110	
> 111	10. **The Canvas is Sacred** — the `/app/canvas` page is the brand's signature surface. No degraded experience there, ever.

> 154	## 🎨 UI / DESIGN STANDARDS
> 155	
> 156	- **Theme:** Dark default. Light mode optional via Tailwind `dark:` classes.
> 157	- **Components:** shadcn/ui only. NEVER hand-roll buttons, inputs, or dialogs from scratch.
> 158	- **Icons:** Lucide React exclusively. No emoji in UI (except brand accents).
> 159	- **Spacing:** Tailwind scale (`p-4`, `gap-6`). NEVER pixel values in className.
> 160	- **Colors:** Use design tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`). NEVER hardcode hex except in design-system file.
> 161	- **Typography:** Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for code/numbers.
> 162	- **Animations:** Framer Motion, max 300ms duration. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
> 163	- **Forms:** React Hook Form + Zod schema validation. Inline error messages.
> 164	- **Toasts:** sonner (shadcn integration).
> 165	- **Modals:** Radix Dialog via shadcn/ui.
> 166	
> 167	**Layout primitives:**
> 168	- Top nav: `<TopNav />` (logo + workspace switcher + global search + credits + user menu)
> 169	- Sidebar: `<AppSidebar />` (module nav, collapsible on mobile)
> 170	- Content: `<AppShell>` wrapper
> 171	- Right panel: `<RightPanel />` (context-specific, collapsible)

> 174	
> 175	## 🗄️ DATABASE CONVENTIONS
> 176	
> 177	- All tables in `public` schema unless explicitly noted.
> 178	- **Every table has:** `id UUID PK`, `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ`, `updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ` (where mutable).
> 179	- **Multi-tenant tables have:** `workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`.
> 180	- **Soft delete:** use `archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ` not `is_deleted BOOLEAN`. Never `DELETE` user content.
> 181	- **JSONB over EAV:** flexible fields go in `metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'`.
> 182	- **Enums for known sets:** define PostgreSQL `CREATE TYPE` enums for finite values.
> 183	- **RLS:** EVERY table. `ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` + `FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY`. Policies use `is_workspace_member()` / `is_workspace_admin()` helpers.
> 184	- **Indexes:** on every FK, every column used in WHERE, every `created_at DESC` for time queries.
> 185	- **Migrations:** numbered files in `supabase/migrations/`. Format: `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_description.sql`. Never edit a migration after merge.
> 186	
> 187	**Reading data from frontend:**
> 188	```ts
> 189	// ✅ Correct: use Supabase client with RLS
> 190	const { data } = await supabase.from('content_items').select('*').eq('workspace_id', wsId);
> 191	
> 192	// ❌ Wrong: NEVER use service_role from client
> 193	// ❌ Wrong: NEVER write raw SQL from client
> 194	```
> 195	
> 196	**Writing data:** ALWAYS through Edge Functions. Client never writes directly to mutable tables except per RLS policy.
> 197	
> 198	---
> 199	
> 200	## 🚪 EDGE FUNCTIONS CONVENTIONS
> 201	
> 202	Location: `supabase/functions/<name>/index.ts`
> 203	
> 204	**Mandatory structure:**
> 205	```ts
> 206	import { serve } from 'https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts';
> 207	import { corsHeaders, validateAuth, errorResponse } from '../_shared/utils.ts';
> 208	
> 209	interface RequestBody { /* zod schema */ }
> 210	
> 211	serve(async (req) => {
> 212	  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders });
> 213	
> 214	  try {
> 215	    const { user, workspace } = await validateAuth(req);
> 216	    const body: RequestBody = await req.json();
> 217	    // ... business logic
> 218	    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ data: result }), {
> 219	      headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
> 220	    });
> 221	  } catch (err) {
> 222	    return errorResponse(err);
> 223	  }
> 224	});
> 225	```
> 226	
> 227	**Rules:**
> 228	- ALWAYS validate auth via `validateAuth()` helper (JWT verification + workspace membership check).
> 229	- ALWAYS validate input with Zod.
> 230	- ALWAYS use service_role client for DB writes (the RLS-bypassing one).
> 231	- ALWAYS catch errors and return structured error responses.
> 232	- ALWAYS log to console (captured by Supabase logs).
> 233	- ALWAYS handle CORS preflight (`OPTIONS`).
> 234	- Credit-consuming operations ALWAYS call `consume_credits()` PostgreSQL function with proper refund logic on failure.

> 237	
> 238	## 🤖 AGENT SYSTEM (MCORCH-COMPATIBLE)
> 239	
> 240	VIRALmind uses a **5-agent BoK system** plus a master orchestrator. Each agent has a dedicated prompt in `agents/`.
> 241	
> 242	| Agent | Domain | Responsibility |
> 243	|---|---|---|
> 244	| **EABOK** | Enterprise Architecture | Architectural decisions, GraphRAG governance, integration patterns |
> 245	| **BPM CBOK** | Business Process Management | Workflow design, n8n orchestration, process optimization |
> 246	| **SWEBOK** | Software Engineering | Code quality, CI/CD, testing, security, performance |
> 247	| **CXBOK** | Customer Experience | UX consistency, journey optimization, NPS/CSAT monitoring |
> 248	| **ProdBOK** | Product Management | Roadmap, prioritization, GTM, pricing decisions |
> 249	| **ORCHESTRATOR** | Master | Event routing, conflict resolution, milestone tracking |
> 250	
> 251	**Operational rules:**
> 252	- Every significant decision logged as `mcorch_node` of type `decision`.
> 253	- Every workflow execution logged as `agent_runs` row.
> 254	- Cross-agent communication via events in n8n + GraphRAG updates.
> 255	- Agents NEVER modify same file simultaneously — check `.tasks/LOCKS.md` first.
> 256	- When two agents conflict: ORCHESTRATOR arbitrates. EABOK has veto on autonomic principle violations.
> 257	
> 258	**Agent prompts are operational, not aspirational.** Read `agents/<name>.md` before invoking an agent.
> 259	
> 260	---
> 261	
> 262	## 🔄 EXECUTION WORKFLOW
> 263	
> 264	When you (Claude Code) receive a task:
> 265	
> 266	### 1. Pre-flight Check
> 267	
> 268	```bash
> 269	# Read these in order, EVERY session:
> 270	1. cat CLAUDE.md (this file)
> 271	2. cat .tasks/LOCKS.md (active file locks)
> 272	3. cat .tasks/ACTIVE.md (concurrent tasks)
> 273	```
> 274	
> 275	### 2. Task Classification
> 276	
> 277	| Task type | Approach |
> 278	|---|---|
> 279	| Feature implementation | Read PRD section → check existing code → propose minimal change → implement |
> 280	| Bug fix | Reproduce → identify root cause → fix → add regression test |
> 281	| Architecture decision | Update `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` with ADR before code |
> 282	| Schema change | Create new migration file → never edit existing |
> 283	| New Edge Function | Follow Edge Functions template above |
> 284	| New integration | Update `docs/INTEGRATIONS-MATRIX.md` first |
> 285	| Performance issue | Measure → identify bottleneck → fix → verify with metrics |
> 286	
> 287	### 3. Pre-Write Lock
> 288	
> 289	Before writing ANY file:
> 290	```bash
> 291	echo "$(date -Iseconds) | <file-path> | <task-description>" >> .tasks/LOCKS.md
> 292	```
> 293	
> 294	After completing, remove the lock line.
> 295	
> 296	### 4. Implementation Principles
> 297	
> 298	- **Smallest possible change.** No drive-by refactors. No "while I'm here" cleanups.
> 299	- **Existing patterns over new patterns.** If similar code exists, match its style.
> 300	- **Types are mandatory.** TypeScript strict mode. No `any` without justification comment.
> 301	- **Tests for non-trivial logic.** Especially: credit math, RLS policies, billing flows, link tracking.
> 302	- **No comments stating the obvious.** Comments explain WHY, not WHAT.
> 303	- **Commit messages: imperative present.** "Add", "Fix", "Refactor" — not "Added"/"Fixed".
> 304	
> 305	### 5. Post-Write Tasks
> 306	
> 307	- Update `mcorch_nodes` / `mcorch_edges` for any new entity or relationship.
> 308	- Add to `system_milestones` for significant deliverables.
> 309	- Update `.tasks/COMPLETED.md` with the task summary.
> 310	- Trigger n8n workflow if cross-module impact (e.g., new feature affects analytics).
> 311	- Generate `### 🔄 SYNC UPDATE` block at end of response.

> 359	## 🚨 ANTI-PATTERNS (NEVER DO THESE)
> 360	
> 361	### Frontend
> 362	- ❌ `fetch(SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY...)` — service_role NEVER in frontend
> 363	- ❌ Business logic in React components (extract to Edge Function or hook)
> 364	- ❌ `localStorage` for auth tokens (use Supabase session)
> 365	- ❌ Inline styles or hardcoded colors (use Tailwind + design tokens)
> 366	- ❌ `any` type without comment justifying it
> 367	- ❌ Direct DB writes from client beyond what RLS allows
> 368	
> 369	### Backend
> 370	- ❌ SELECT without WHERE in user-facing queries (always filter by workspace)
> 371	- ❌ Storing API keys/secrets in env files committed to git
> 372	- ❌ Synchronous API calls that take > 5s (use background jobs)
> 373	- ❌ Eager loading entire tables (always paginate)
> 374	- ❌ Implicit casts in SQL (always explicit `::type`)
> 375	
> 376	### Architecture
> 377	- ❌ Modifying a deployed migration (always new migration)
> 378	- ❌ Coupling Edge Functions to specific Supabase IDs (use env vars)
> 379	- ❌ Bypassing RLS by always using service_role (only for legitimate server-side ops)
> 380	- ❌ Hardcoded magic strings (use enums + constants)
> 381	- ❌ Adding a new external service without `docs/INTEGRATIONS-MATRIX.md` entry
> 382	
> 383	### Process
> 384	- ❌ Writing to a file without checking `.tasks/LOCKS.md`
> 385	- ❌ Skipping the `mcorch_node` creation for new entities
> 386	- ❌ Not generating `### 🔄 SYNC UPDATE` block
> 387	- ❌ Asking permission for individual steps (proceed autonomously)
> 388	- ❌ Adding introductory text, greetings, or recaps to responses

> 459	## 💰 CREDIT SYSTEM REFERENCE
> 460	
> 461	```ts
> 462	// Always use the consume_credits() PostgreSQL function:
> 463	const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('consume_credits', {
> 464	  p_workspace_id: workspaceId,
> 465	  p_user_id: userId,
> 466	  p_amount: 12,
> 467	  p_reference_type: 'canvas_node',
> 468	  p_reference_id: nodeId,
> 469	  p_description: 'FLUX Pro image generation'
> 470	});
> 471	
> 472	if (data?.success === false) {
> 473	  // Insufficient credits — return upgrade CTA
> 474	}
> 475	
> 476	// On operation failure, ALWAYS refund:
> 477	await supabase.rpc('refund_credits', { /* ... */ });
> 478	```
> 479	
> 480	**Credit costs:** see PRD §8.2 (canonical table).
> 481	**Refund policy:** automatic on generation failure, no manual refunds in v1.0.
> 482	**Cycle reset:** monthly grant via Stripe webhook → `credit_grant` transaction.

> 573	## 🧠 SPECIAL CASES & EDGE BEHAVIORS
> 574	
> 575	### Canvas Studio Performance
> 576	- Canvas must maintain ≥ 60 fps even with 100+ nodes.
> 577	- Heavy computations off the main thread (Web Workers or RAF).
> 578	- Image previews lazy-loaded.
> 579	- Async generation status via Supabase Realtime subscription.
> 580	
> 581	### Video Generation Long-Running Jobs
> 582	- Edge Functions have 60s timeout limit.
> 583	- Use queue + worker pattern: Edge Function enqueues, worker processes, Realtime updates UI.
> 584	- User receives in-app notification + email when complete.
> 585	
> 586	### Affiliate Link Click Handling
> 587	- Public endpoint (no auth): `/r/:shortCode`
> 588	- Edge Function logs click → 302 redirect to destination
> 589	- Click logging is non-blocking (fire-and-forget if logger slow)
> 590	- Bot detection via UA + behavioral patterns
> 591	
> 592	### Webhook Idempotency
> 593	- All webhook handlers idempotent by `external_id` or `event_id`.
> 594	- Store processed event IDs in dedup table.
> 595	- Stripe: verify signature before processing.
> 596	
> 597	### Multi-Workspace Switching
> 598	- Workspace ID stored in JWT custom claim (set by Supabase Auth Hook).
> 599	- All queries scoped by workspace_id from JWT, not from request body.
> 600	- Switching workspace = re-issue JWT.

> 604	## 🚀 DEPLOYMENT PROCEDURE
> 605	
> 606	### Staging Deploy (Automated on `develop` branch merge)
> 607	1. CI runs lint + typecheck + unit + E2E tests
> 608	2. Migrations applied to staging DB
> 609	3. Edge Functions deployed
> 610	4. Frontend deployed to staging environment
> 611	5. Smoke tests run automatically
> 612	6. Slack notification
> 613	
> 614	### Production Deploy (Manual approval on `main` branch)
> 615	1. All staging checks pass
> 616	2. CHANGELOG.md updated
> 617	3. Manual approval required (Gabriel)
> 618	4. Migrations applied with rollback ready
> 619	5. Edge Functions deployed with feature flags
> 620	6. Frontend deployed with canary strategy (10% → 50% → 100%)
> 621	7. Production health checks monitored for 15 min
> 622	8. Slack notification + Sentry release marker
> 623	
> 624	### Rollback Procedure
> 625	- See `docs/RUNBOOKS/rollback.md`
> 626	- Edge Functions: `supabase functions deploy <name> --version <prev>`
> 627	- Frontend: revert via deploy platform (Vercel/Cloudflare Pages)
> 628	- Database: forward-only migrations; data fix via new migration if needed

\u2014 Supabase client handles this)\n- [ ] Webhook endpoints verify signatures (Stripe, affiliate networks)\n- [ ] Audit log entries for all admin actions\n- [ ] LGPD/GDPR: user can request export + deletion within 30 days\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udcb0 CREDIT SYSTEM REFERENCE\n\n```ts\n// Always use the consume_credits() PostgreSQL function:\nconst { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('consume_credits', {\n  p_workspace_id: workspaceId,\n  p_user_id: userId,\n  p_amount: 12,\n  p_reference_type: 'canvas_node',\n  p_reference_id: nodeId,\n  p_description: 'FLUX Pro image generation'\n});\n\nif (data?.success === false) {\n  // Insufficient credits \u2014 return upgrade CTA\n}\n\n// On operation failure, ALWAYS refund:\nawait supabase.rpc('refund_credits', { /* ... */ });\n```\n\n**Credit costs:** see PRD \u00a78.2 (canonical table).\n**Refund policy:** automatic on generation failure, no manual refunds in v1.0.\n**Cycle reset:** monthly grant via Stripe webhook \u2192 `credit_grant` transaction.\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udcca OBSERVABILITY\n\n**Required telemetry for every Edge Function:**\n- Request count + duration (histogram)\n- Error rate (by error type)\n- Credits consumed (counter)\n- External API call duration + status\n\n**Required telemetry for every worker:**\n- Jobs processed/failed/queued\n- Processing duration (p50/p95/p99)\n- External API quota consumption\n\n**Dashboards to maintain:**\n- Business: MCOPM, MRR, conversion rates, ROAS, churn\n- Product: feature adoption, funnel completion, time-to-first-value\n- Engineering: API latency, error rates, queue depths, deploy frequency\n- AI Costs: model usage, $ per operation, credit-to-cost ratio\n\n**Alerts (PagerDuty):**\n- P0: production down, payment processing failure, DB unavailable\n- P1: error rate > 5%, p99 latency > 2s, queue backlog > 5min\n- P2: AI provider degradation, individual integration failures\n- P3: anomaly detection (unusual spend patterns, etc.)\n\n---\n\n## \ud83c\udf10 INTERNATIONALIZATION\n\n- All user-facing strings externalized to `apps/web/src/i18n/<locale>.json`.\n- Default locale: `pt-BR`. Fallback: `en-US`.\n- Date formatting: `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with user locale.\n- Currency: `Intl.NumberFormat` with workspace currency.\n- Never hardcode strings in components \u2014 even error messages.\n\n```tsx\n// \u2705 Correct\nconst { t } = useTranslation();\n<Button>{t('common.save')}</Button>\n\n// \u274c Wrong\n<Button>Salvar</Button>\n```\n\n---\n\n## \ud83c\udfa4 RESPONSE FORMAT (FOR CLAUDE CODE)\n\nWhen responding to Gabriel:\n\n- **No introductory text, greetings, or recaps.** Get to the point.\n- **Brazilian Portuguese for prose.** English for code, file paths, command names, error messages.\n- **High-effort mode is default.** Don't ask permission for individual steps. Proceed autonomously.\n- **Show, don't tell.** Output code and diffs, not descriptions of what you'll do.\n- **Surface decisions.** When choosing between approaches, state the tradeoff in 1 sentence.\n- **Every significant response ends with:**\n\n```\n### \ud83d\udd04 SYNC UPDATE\n\nENTITY: <thing-affected>\nTYPE: <feature|fix|refactor|decision|integration>\nSTATUS: <created|updated|completed|blocked>\nRELATIONS:\n  \u2192 <related-entity>: <nature-of-relation>\nNEXT-ACTION: <what-comes-next-or-NONE>\n```\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udcda REFERENCE DOCS\n\n| Document | Purpose |\n|---|---|\n| `PRD.md` | Product requirements, personas, scope, OKRs |\n| `DATABASE-SCHEMA.sql` | Canonical Supabase schema with RLS |\n| `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` | C4 diagrams + Architecture Decision Records |\n| `docs/API-CONTRACT.yaml` | OpenAPI 3.1 spec for all Edge Functions |\n| `docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` | Visual tokens, components, layout patterns |\n| `docs/INTEGRATIONS-MATRIX.md` | External APIs: auth, rate limits, webhooks |\n| `docs/EDGE-FUNCTIONS-SPEC.md` | Function-by-function input/output/auth |\n| `agents/<name>.md` | Per-agent operational prompts |\n| `docs/RUNBOOKS/<incident>.md` | Incident response playbooks |\n| `VIRALmind-SDD-v1.0.docx` | Software Design Document (parent doc) |\n\n---\n\n## \ud83e\udde0 SPECIAL CASES & EDGE BEHAVIORS\n\n### Canvas Studio Performance\n- Canvas must maintain \u2265 60 fps even with 100+ nodes.\n- Heavy computations off the main thread (Web Workers or RAF).\n- Image previews lazy-loaded.\n- Async generation status via Supabase Realtime subscription.\n\n### Video Generation Long-Running Jobs\n- Edge Functions have 60s timeout limit.\n- Use queue + worker pattern: Edge Function enqueues, worker processes, Realtime updates UI.\n- User receives in-app notification + email when complete.\n\n### Affiliate Link Click Handling\n- Public endpoint (no auth): `/r/:shortCode`\n- Edge Function logs click \u2192 302 redirect to destination\n- Click logging is non-blocking (fire-and-forget if logger slow)\n- Bot detection via UA + behavioral patterns\n\n### Webhook Idempotency\n- All webhook handlers idempotent by `external_id` or `event_id`.\n- Store processed event IDs in dedup table.\n- Stripe: verify signature before processing.\n\n### Multi-Workspace Switching\n- Workspace ID stored in JWT custom claim (set by Supabase Auth Hook).\n- All queries scoped by workspace_id from JWT, not from request body.\n- Switching workspace = re-issue JWT.\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\ude80 DEPLOYMENT PROCEDURE\n\n### Staging Deploy (Automated on `develop` branch merge)\n1. CI runs lint + typecheck + unit + E2E tests\n2. Migrations applied to staging DB\n3. Edge Functions deployed\n4. Frontend deployed to staging environment\n5. Smoke tests run automatically\n6. Slack notification\n\n### Production Deploy (Manual approval on `main` branch)\n1. All staging checks pass\n2. CHANGELOG.md updated\n3. Manual approval required (Gabriel)\n4. Migrations applied with rollback ready\n5. Edge Functions deployed with feature flags\n6. Frontend deployed with canary strategy (10% \u2192 50% \u2192 100%)\n7. Production health checks monitored for 15 min\n8. Slack notification + Sentry release marker\n\n### Rollback Procedure\n- See `docs/RUNBOOKS/rollback.md`\n- Edge Functions: `supabase functions deploy <name> --version <prev>`\n- Frontend: revert via deploy platform (Vercel/Cloudflare Pages)\n- Database: forward-only migrations; data fix via new migration if needed\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udd04 SYNC UPDATE TEMPLATE\n\nEvery significant Claude Code response ends with this block:\n\n```\n### \ud83d\udd04 SYNC UPDATE\n\nENTITY: <thing-affected>\nTYPE: <feature|fix|refactor|decision|integration|schema|infra>\nSTATUS: <created|updated|completed|blocked|deferred>\nRELATIONS:\n  \u2192 <related-entity>: <nature-of-relation>\n  \u2192 <related-entity>: <nature-of-relation>\nMCORCH-NODES-CREATED: [<node-uuids>]\nNEXT-ACTION: <what-comes-next-or-NONE>\nLOCKS-HELD: [<file-paths-still-locked>]\n```\n\nThis block is then ingested by the BPM CBOK agent for cross-task awareness.\n\n---\n\n## \u26a0\ufe0f FINAL DIRECTIVES\n\n1. **You are augmenting a solo founder.** Time is the scarcest resource. Optimize for unblocking, not for completeness.\n\n2. **The autonomic principle is sacred.** If a feature requires constant human attention to operate, it's poorly designed. Iterate until it self-manages.\n\n3. **The knowledge graph is the source of truth.** When in doubt, query the graph. ORCHESTRATOR for conflicts.\n\n---\n\n\u2192 ALIGN  \u2192  INTEGRATE  \u2192  OPTIMIZE  \u2192  INNOVATE  \u2192  TRANSFORM  \u2192  DELIVER VALUE\n\n**SYSTEM STATUS: ALL SYSTEMS OPERATIONAL**\n\n*CLAUDE.md v1.0 \u00b7 VIRALmind \u00b7 MCORCH Ecosystem \u00b7 mcorch.com \u00b7 May 2026*\n"

> 77	| SOL-003 | KPI-007 mesh growth = 0 por 7d | mcorch_nodes | Trigger backfill embeddings (recipes) via cron one-shot | Alert se backfill falha |
> 78	| SOL-004 | KPI-011 refund rate > 1% em 24h | mco_transactions | Pause Edge Fn problemático; refund batch automático | Sovereign decide se rollback ou patch |
> 79	| SOL-005 | KPI-014 sessões > 25min sem pausa em VirtualScene | activity log | Modal "Que tal uma pausa?" com botão "Continuar" | None (UX gentle) |
> 80	| SOL-006 | mcoCoins balance < 10% do plan quota | profiles | In-app notification PT-BR + CTA top-up | None (user choice) |
> 81	| SOL-007 | KPI-010 storage > 80% do limite | Storage stats | Trigger PROC-009 (orphan cleanup) imediatamente | Alert se cleanup não recupera 10% |
> 82

> 84	
> 85	## 5. Self-Healing Specifications
> 86	
> 87	### 5.1 Watchdog Telemetry Events
> 88	
> 89	New event types written to `infra_health_logs` by this feature:
> 90	
> 91	| Event Type | Trigger | Severity | Payload |
> 92	|------------|---------|----------|---------|
> 93	| `canvas_fn_failure` | Edge Fn 5xx after retry exhaustion | error | `{fn_name, error_message, user_id, shape_id, document_id}` |
> 94	| `canvas_embed_failure` | embed-mcorch-node timeout para recipe | warn | `{recipe_id, retry_count}` |
> 95	| `canvas_sla_breach` | Process SLA exceeded | warn | `{process_id, elapsed_ms, threshold_ms, document_id}` |
> 96	| `canvas_mcp_method_unknown` | Tool não-allowlisted invocado | warn | `{method, source_jwt_user}` |
> 97	| `canvas_realtime_drift` | Multiplayer drift > 1s | warn | `{document_id, drift_ms}` |
> 98	| `canvas_storage_warning` | Snapshot size > 4MB | info | `{document_id, size_bytes}` |
> 99	| `canvas_refund_issued` | Refund automático após gen failure | info | `{user_id, amount, reason}` |
> 100	| `canvas_orphan_cleanup` | Cron PROC-009 completou | info | `{deleted_count, freed_bytes}` |
> 101	
> 102	### 5.2 Auto-Recovery Script Stubs
> 103	
> 104	```bash
> 105	#!/bin/bash
> 106	# scripts/self-heal-conteudo-v2.sh
> 107	# Triggered by mega-brain-daemon when canvas_fn_failure detected
> 108	
> 109	FUNCTION_NAME="$1"  # generate-image | canvas-mcp | etc.
> 110	LOG_TABLE="infra_health_logs"
> 111	
> 112	echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] Self-heal triggered for $FUNCTION_NAME"
> 113	
> 114	# Step 1: Health probe
> 115	STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
> 116	  "$SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/$FUNCTION_NAME/health" \
> 117	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")
> 118	
> 119	if [ "$STATUS" != "200" ]; then
> 120	  echo "[WARN] Function unhealthy (status: $STATUS). Re-deploying..."
> 121	  npx supabase functions deploy "$FUNCTION_NAME"
> 122	
> 123	  # Step 2: Verify post-deploy
> 124	  sleep 5
> 125	  STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
> 126	    "$SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/$FUNCTION_NAME/health")
> 127	
> 128	  if [ "$STATUS" != "200" ]; then
> 129	    echo "[CRITICAL] Re-deploy did not heal. Escalating to Sovereign."
> 130	    # Insert critical event
> 131	  else
> 132	    echo "[OK] Self-heal successful."
> 133	  fi
> 134	fi
> 135	```
> 136	
> 137	### 5.3 mega-brain-daemon Integration Points
> 138	
> 139	| Daemon Event | Condition | Action |
> 140	|-------------|-----------|--------|
> 141	| `health_check` | Every 5 min (existing watchdog cron) | Probe `/functions/v1/canvas-mcp/health`; verify Realtime channel `canvas:*` ativo |
> 142	| `anomaly_detected` | error rate > 5/hour para `canvas_fn_failure` | Execute `self-heal-conteudo-v2.sh <fn_name>` |
> 143	| `recovery_confirmed` | Health probe passa após self-heal | Insert `recovery_ok` event para `infra_health_logs` |
> 144	| `sustained_degradation` | KPI-004 > critical por > 1h | Page Sovereign via webhook (Phase 8 — Slack/email) |

> 153	| `generate-video` API (canvas) | p95 response latency | ≤ 120s (Veo) / ≤ 90s (Kling) | rescue-video gratuito; refund se > 240s |
> 154	| `canvas-mcp` API | p95 latency | ≤ 800ms | None Phase 8 (interno); Y2 SLA contratual Enterprise |
> 155	| Canvas auto-save | p95 latency | ≤ 800ms | Save offline para localStorage; resync ao reconectar |
> 156	| Recipe embedding | % nodes embedded em 5min | ≥ 95% | Auto-backfill cron mensal |
> 157	| Multiplayer drift | p95 cursor latency | ≤ 500ms | Degrade graceful para polling |
> 158	| Platform uptime | % minutes available per month | ≥ 99.5% | Per Enterprise contract |
> 159	| LGPD data export | Time to export all canvas data | ≤ 30s para 100 docs | Manual escalation se > 60s |

> 12	A produção de conteúdo criativo de fronteira em 2026 migrou definitivamente de interfaces de chat lineares para **canvas nodais multimodais** — espaços infinitos onde imagens, vídeos, áudios e cenas 3D se encadeiam por arrastar-e-soltar, modelos diferentes são comparados lado-a-lado, e fluxos validados são encapsulados como Receitas reutilizáveis. Plataformas como Martini.art, Magnific (Freepik) e Krea estabeleceram esse paradigma e cobram R$120-180/mês de assinatura. O ecossistema MCORCH possui já hoje 90% da infraestrutura técnica necessária (Edge Functions de generate-image, generate-video, tts-speak; mcoCoins gatekeeper atômico; Knowledge Mesh com pgvector; React 18 + R3F + Zustand) — falta apenas o **canvas multimodal soberano** que unifica essas capacidades em uma superfície de autoria coesa. Conteúdo v2 entrega esse canvas, eliminando dependência de assinaturas externas e capturando o gasto criativo dos usuários MCORCH dentro do próprio ledger mcoCoins.
> 13	
> 14	---
> 15	
> 16	## 2. Market Problem Statement
> 17	
> 18	### 2.1 Current State
> 19	
> 20	Criadores de conteúdo (creators, agências, comunicadores) que querem produzir mídia gerada por IA hoje pulam entre 4-7 ferramentas isoladas: ChatGPT/Claude para prompt engineering, Midjourney/Flux para imagens, Runway/Veo para vídeo, ElevenLabs para áudio, Photoshop/Canva para composição. Cada ferramenta cobra assinatura mensal própria (R$80-300), tem suas próprias credenciais, e nenhuma delas conversa com as outras. O fluxo "imagem A → estende para vídeo B → adiciona narração C" exige download, upload e re-prompt manuais a cada handoff.
> 21	
> 22	### 2.2 Root Cause Analysis
> 23	
> 24	A indústria de IA generativa é fragmentada por design — cada provedor (OpenAI, Black Forest, Runway, Google, Anthropic) opera silos isolados com APIs próprias. Plataformas que tentam unificar (Magnific, Freepik AI Suite, Martini.art) o fazem em nuvens fechadas, capturando dados de prompts, imagens geradas e padrões criativos como ativo proprietário. O criador paga assinatura E cede telemetria criativa. Não existe alternativa **soberana** (que rode em infraestrutura controlada pelo criador/empresa) que ofereça paridade de UX com essas suites cloud.
> 25	
> 26	### 2.3 Desired State
> 27	
> 28	Um canvas nodal multimodal hospedado dentro do ecossistema MCORCH onde:
> 29	1. O criador arrasta um nó "Imagem", digita um prompt, conecta a um nó "Vídeo Estende", conecta a um nó "Voz" — tudo em um espaço infinito.
> 30	2. Cada geração consome mcoCoins (já no ledger do usuário), sem nova assinatura.
> 31	3. Receitas validadas viram templates reutilizáveis pela equipe.
> 32	4. Dados de prompts e gerações ficam no Supabase do próprio MCORCH, sob LGPD soberana.
> 33	5. O AIOS (mega-brain) atua como co-piloto via MCP, sugerindo nós ou orquestrando sub-grafos automaticamente.

> 120	## 7. Constraints & Assumptions
> 121	
> 122	### Constraints
> 123	- C-001: Limite semanal Claude (200k context window por sessão) força execução em phases — não pode tudo em um sprint.
> 124	- C-002: Bundle size do front deve ficar < 2MB gzipped (Lighthouse) — tldraw + R3F + timelines exige code-splitting agressivo por phase.
> 125	- C-003: LGPD impede armazenar prompt de menores (< 18 anos) sem consentimento parental — gate de signup já filtra.
> 126	- C-004: Modelos externos (Veo, Kling) podem ter rate limits que limitam concorrência em horários de pico.
> 127	- C-005: tldraw 4.x está em SDK (não free) — verificar licenciamento OSS para uso comercial soberano (resolver em Phase 1.0).
> 128	
> 129	### Assumptions
> 130	- A-001: Usuários atuais MCORCH são receptivos a um novo módulo (validado pelo Sovereign Zero como piloto).
> 131	- A-002: OpenRouter manterá disponibilidade de NanoBanana/Flux/Veo nos próximos 12 meses.
> 132	- A-003: Supabase Realtime suporta volume de mensagens (10-50 cursores simultâneos por documento) sem upgrade de plano.
> 133	- A-004: Stripe live keys serão configuradas antes de Phase 8 (já desbloqueadas pelo LGPD seal v5.8.0).
> 134	- A-005: Sovereign mantém autoridade decisória final em OTDs e priorização de phases.

> 147	| BR-RISK-006 | Multiplayer tldraw + Supabase Realtime apresentar drift de estado | 3 | 3 | 9 | Postgres-as-SSOT (não Y.js CRDT); reconciliação on-conflict via versão monotônica |
> 148	| BR-RISK-007 | mcoCoins burn rate exceder revenue (canvas vira centro de custo) | 3 | 5 | 15 | Telemetria por user; alert se cost-per-MAU > revenue-per-MAU; ajuste rápido de coin/operation |
> 149	| BR-RISK-008 | Adoção pelos early adopters abaixo do esperado (D30 retention < 35%) | 3 | 4 | 12 | Onboarding tour; Receitas pré-fabricadas; quick-win templates |

> 151	| BR-RISK-010 | Tomada de decisão lenta nas OTDs por sobrecarga do Sovereign | 4 | 3 | 12 | OTDs com recomendação default + timebox de 48h; agente bok-scribe documenta automaticamente |

> 129	## 4. Interface Requirements
> 130	
> 131	### 4.1 UI → Hook → Edge Function Contract
> 132	
> 133	```
> 134	[Component: ContentCanvas]
> 135	  ↓ (renders Custom Shape)
> 136	[Shape: ImageGeneratorShapeUtil]
> 137	  ↓ (onGenerate → calls hook)
> 138	[Hook: useImageGeneration]
> 139	  ↓ (POST + JWT)
> 140	[Edge Function: generate-image]
> 141	  ↓ (deduct_mco_coins RPC)
> 142	[DB: profiles.mco_balance]
> 143	  ↓ (calls)
> 144	[External API: OpenRouter (NanoBanana / Flux / Gemini)]
> 145	  ↓ (image URL)
> 146	[DB: content_library + content_canvas_documents.snapshot]
> 147	  ↓ (TanStack Query invalidation)
> 148	[UI: Shape props updated → output renders]
> 149	```
> 150	
> 151	### 4.2 External API Contracts
> 152	
> 153	#### `POST /functions/v1/generate-image` (existing — extended)
> 154	
> 155	**Auth:** Bearer JWT (user scope)
> 156	**Request:**
> 157	```typescript
> 158	{
> 159	  prompt: string;                // user prompt
> 160	  model: 'nanobanana' | 'flux2' | 'gemini-image';
> 161	  aspectRatio?: '1:1' | '16:9' | '9:16' | '4:5';
> 162	  canvas_node_id?: string;       // NEW: link back to ImageGeneratorShape ID
> 163	  document_id?: string;          // NEW: parent canvas document
> 164	}
> 165	```
> 166	**Response (200):**
> 167	```typescript
> 168	{
> 169	  status: 'ok';
> 170	  image_url: string;
> 171	  content_id: string;
> 172	  mcoCoins_balance: number;
> 173	  chunks?: number;               // for embedding telemetry
> 174	}
> 175	```
> 176	**Error codes:**
> 177	| Code | Condition |
> 178	|------|-----------|
> 179	| 401 | Missing or invalid JWT |
> 180	| 402 | Insufficient mcoCoins balance |
> 181	| 422 | Validation failure (prompt empty, model invalid) |
> 182	| 429 | OpenRouter rate-limit |
> 183	| 500 | Internal error (logged to infra_health_logs) |
> 184	
> 185	#### `POST /functions/v1/canvas-mcp` (NEW — Phase 8)
> 186	
> 187	**Auth:** Bearer JWT
> 188	**Request (JSON-RPC 2.0):**
> 189	```typescript
> 190	{
> 191	  jsonrpc: '2.0';
> 192	  id: number;
> 193	  method: 'canvas.create_node' | 'canvas.update_node' | 'canvas.delete_node' | 'canvas.execute_recipe' | 'canvas.list_documents';
> 194	  params: { document_id: string; ... };
> 195	}
> 196	```
> 197	**Response:**
> 198	```typescript
> 199	{
> 200	  jsonrpc: '2.0';
> 201	  id: number;
> 202	  result?: any;
> 203	  error?: { code: number; message: string; data?: any };
> 204	}
> 205	```

> 26	[content_canvas_documents] ──(observation)──▶ [mcorch_nodes]
> 27	[content_canvas_recipes]   ──(documentation_suite seal)──▶ [mcorch_nodes]
> 28	```
> 29	
> 30	**Entities:**
> 31	- **content_canvas_documents:** Documento de canvas (snapshot tldraw + metadados de colaboração)
> 32	- **content_canvas_recipes:** Sub-grafo serializado reutilizável; embedded para busca semântica
> 33	- **content_canvas_assets:** Cada asset (imagem/vídeo/áudio/3d) gerado dentro do canvas, com referência ao shape_id que o originou
> 34	- **user_voices:** Voice clones treinados pelo user; referenciados em TTS/voice nodes
> 35	- **mcorch_nodes (extension):** Observation nodes para cada execução significativa no canvas (Recipe save, Recipe apply, generation milestone)
> 36

> 150	## 4. GraphRAG Knowledge Nodes
> 151	
> 152	### Node Types Introduced
> 153	
> 154	| node_type | Title Pattern | Content Fields | Embedding Source |
> 155	|-----------|--------------|----------------|-----------------|
> 156	| `canvas_recipe` | `Recipe: <recipe.name>` | `name + description + snapshot summary` | concatenation → embed-mcorch-node |
> 157	| `canvas_milestone` | `Canvas milestone: <doc title> @ <date>` | `title + key actions taken` | summary text |
> 158	| `canvas_aios_action` | `AIOS action: <method> on <document>` | `MCP method + params + outcome` | params JSON serialized |
> 159	| `documentation_suite` (existing) | `bok-scribe-seal-conteudo-v2-v1` | BoK synthesis (this doc itself) | full BoK summary |
> 160	
> 161	### Edge Types Introduced
> 162	
> 163	| Edge relationship | Source node_type | Target node_type | Metadata |
> 164	|-------------------|-----------------|-----------------|----------|
> 165	| `INSPIRED_BY` | `canvas_recipe` | `canvas_recipe` | `similarity_score` (when user creates recipe semantically close to existing) |
> 166	| `EXECUTED_IN` | `canvas_milestone` | `documentation_suite` | `phase: 'P2' \| 'P3' \| ...` |
> 167	| `INVOKED_BY` | `canvas_aios_action` | `mega-brain-daemon-config` | `timestamp + tool` |
> 168	
> 169	### Embedding Trigger
> 170	
> 171	Every insert into `content_canvas_recipes` calls `embed-mcorch-node` via existing pg_net trigger:
> 172	```typescript
> 173	// Implicitly via trigger trg_recipes_embed_on_insert.
> 174	// Function input: { node_id: recipe.id, content: `${name} ${description} ${JSON.stringify(snapshot.summary)}` }
> 175	// Output: vector(768) stored in recipe.embedding
> 176	```
> 177	
> 178	For canvas milestones (one per significant action): inserted explicitly by Edge Functions:
> 179	```typescript
> 180	await supabase.from('mcorch_nodes').insert({
> 181	  node_type: 'canvas_milestone',
> 182	  title: `Canvas milestone: ${doc.title}`,
> 183	  content: summaryText,
> 184	  user_id: user.id,
> 185	  stability_score: 0.6,
> 186	  metadata: { document_id, phase, action }
> 187	})
> 188	// Embedding via trg_mcorch_embed_on_insert (existing)
> 189	```
> 190	
> 191	### FSRS-6 Parameters
> 192	
> 193	| Field | Initial Value | Decay Rule |
> 194	|-------|--------------|------------|
> 195	| `stability_score` (recipes) | `0.5` | Bumped to `0.7` after 5 uses (use_count >= 5); decays per migration `20260425190000` formula |
> 196	| `revenue_impact` (recipes) | derived from `use_count × avg_coin_cost` | Updated on each apply via trigger or backfill cron |
> 197	| `stability_score` (canvas_milestone) | `0.6` | Decays normally |

> 231	## 7. Retention & Archival Policy
> 232	
> 233	| Data | Retention Period | Archival Strategy | Deletion Trigger |
> 234	|------|-----------------|-------------------|-----------------|
> 235	| `content_canvas_documents` ativos | Indefinido enquanto user ativo | Backup diário Supabase | User-initiated DELETE ou delete_account() RPC |
> 236	| `content_canvas_documents` órfãos (user deletado) | Imediato via FK CASCADE | — | delete_account() ou ON DELETE CASCADE |
> 237	| `content_canvas_recipes` | Indefinido enquanto user ativo | Embedding indefinido (mesh search) | Same as above |
> 238	| `content_canvas_assets` (image URLs) | 12 meses após geração se shape removido | Cleanup cron mensal: assets sem shape_id correspondente | Cron `0 3 * * 0` (Domingo 3am) |
> 239	| `content_canvas_assets` (Storage buckets) | Same as URLs | Storage cleanup via signed URL expiry | TTL 30d para signed URLs |
> 240	| `user_voices` | Até user revogar consent ou delete_account | — | Manual revoke ou cascade |
> 241	| `mcorch_nodes` canvas_milestone | Indefinido | Embedded para mesh search | delete_account |
> 242	| `infra_health_logs` (canvas events) | 90 dias | Sem archival | Cron purge existente |
> 243	
> 244	**LGPD compliance:** data-export Edge Function (já em produção) inclui `content_canvas_documents`, `content_canvas_recipes`, `content_canvas_assets`, `user_voices` no payload exportado por `userId`. delete_account() RPC propaga via FK CASCADE.

> 248	## 8. Appendix — VIRALmind Table Aliases (v1 reality, 2026-05-14)
> 249	
> 250	A implementação v1 (entregue por Antigravity em Sprints 1-3) usa namespace `vm_*` ao invés do `content_canvas_*` planejado. Mapeamento canônico:
> 251	
> 252	| Plano original (este BoK) | Implementação v1 em produção | Diferenças |
> 253	|---------------------------|------------------------------|------------|
> 254	| `content_canvas_documents` | `vm_canvas_projects` | `canvas_data` JSONB substitui `snapshot` JSONB; sem `version` monotônico (Phase 7) |
> 255	| `content_canvas_recipes` | `vm_canvas_recipes` | mesma estrutura; embedding via mesh seal node |
> 256	| `content_canvas_assets` | `vm_canvas_assets` + `vm_canvas_executions` | desnormalização: assets persistem o resultado final, executions persistem o histórico de runs (com status machine) |
> 257	| `user_voices` | Não implementado (Phase 4 deferred) | Phase 4 audio nodes ainda não materializados |
> 258	
> 259	**Decisão arquitetônica:** rebranding `vm_*` → `content_canvas_*` não é prioritário. O ganho semântico não justifica o custo de migration + types regen. Manter `vm_*` indefinidamente; este BoK passa a ser o **roadmap de evolução** (Phase 4-8) com tabelas adicionais ainda por criar.
> 260	
> 261	**Tabelas vm_* totais em produção (migrations 20260514040*):**
> 262	- `vm_niches` (18 seeded)
> 263	- `vm_trends` (24 seeded)
> 264	- `vm_user_trends` (favorites)
> 265	- `vm_canvas_projects`, `vm_canvas_assets`, `vm_canvas_executions`, `vm_canvas_recipes`
> 266	- `vm_affiliate_products`, `vm_affiliate_links`, `vm_affiliate_clicks`
> 267	
> 268	Ver `docs/bok/viralmind/schema-reference.sql` para o schema canônico VIRALmind.

> 144	  └── Return result + version

> 149	## 3. n8n Workflow Blueprints
> 150	
> 151	### Workflow: Storage Cleanup Orphan Assets (PROC-009)
> 152	
> 153	**Trigger:** Cron `0 3 * * 0` (Domingo 03:00 BRT)
> 154	**Idempotency key:** `cleanup-orphan-${YYYYMMDD}`
> 155	
> 156	```
> 157	[Cron Trigger]
> 158	  │
> 159	  ▼
> 160	[Node: Supabase SELECT distinct shape_id FROM content_canvas_assets]
> 161	  │
> 162	  ▼
> 163	[Node: For each shape_id]
> 164	  │
> 165	  ├── [Check if shape_id exists in any doc.snapshot.shapes]
> 166	  │
> 167	  ├── (orphan) ──▶ [Node: DELETE asset row + Storage object]
> 168	  │                       │
> 169	  │                       ▼
> 170	  │                 [Node: Insert infra_health_logs {event: 'canvas_orphan_cleanup'}]
> 171	  │
> 172	  └── (active) ──▶ [skip]
> 173	```
> 174	
> 175	**Data Mapping:**
> 176	
> 177	| Input Field | Source | → | Output Field | Destination |
> 178	|-------------|--------|---|--------------|-------------|
> 179	| `shape_id` | content_canvas_assets | → | `delete predicate` | DELETE statement |
> 180	| `asset_url` | content_canvas_assets | → | `storage.remove()` arg | Supabase Storage |
> 181	
> 182	### Workflow: Recipe Stability Bump (cron, weekly)
> 183	
> 184	**Trigger:** Cron `0 4 * * 0`
> 185	**Idempotency key:** `recipe-stability-${YYYYMMDD}`

> 187	```

> 189	  │
> 190	  ▼

> 192	  │
> 193	  ▼

> 195	  │

> 236	## 5. Error Handling & Retry Strategy
> 237	
> 238	| Process | Step | Error Type | Max Retries | Backoff | Failure Action |
> 239	|---------|------|-----------|-------------|---------|----------------|
> 240	| PROC-001 | Save snapshot | Network timeout | 3 | Exponential (1s, 2s, 4s) | Save to localStorage as backup; retry on next debounce; toast "Conexão instável" |
> 241	| PROC-002 | OpenRouter call | 5xx / timeout | 3 | Exponential (2s, 4s, 8s) | Insert `infra_health_logs`; toast "Modelo temporariamente indisponível"; refund mcoCoins |
> 242	| PROC-002 | mcoCoins deduct | RPC timeout | 2 | Linear 1s | Idempotency key prevents double charge; toast "Tente novamente" |
> 243	| PROC-005 | Video generation | Long-running | 0 (use polling) | — | rescue-video Edge Function (existing); poll cada 30s; UI mostra progress |
> 244	| PROC-006 | MCP method execution | Tool failure | 1 | None | Return JSON-RPC error; AIOS replan |
> 245	| PROC-008 | Document broadcast | Realtime down | ∞ | Reconnect on heartbeat | Fallback para polling Postgres a cada 5s |
> 246	| Any | JWT validation | Invalid token | 0 | — | HTTP 401 imediato; UI redirect para `/auth` |

> 267	## 7. Cron Jobs
> 268	
> 269	| Job Name | Schedule (cron) | Function | Idempotency | Failure Alerting |
> 270	|----------|----------------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
> 271	| `canvas-orphan-cleanup` | `0 3 * * 0` (Sun 03:00 BRT) | n8n workflow PROC-009 | `cleanup-orphan-${YYYYMMDD}` | infra_health_logs |
> 272	| `canvas-recipe-stability-bump` | `0 4 * * 0` | n8n workflow weekly | `recipe-stability-${YYYYMMDD}` | infra_health_logs |
> 273	| `canvas-thumbnail-refresh` | `0 5 * * *` (daily 05:00 BRT) | Refresh thumbnail PNG para top 100 docs ativos | per-document hash | Sem alert (best-effort) |
> 274	| `watchdog-mcorch.sh` (existente) | `*/5 * * * *` | Já cobre Edge Functions; expandir para canvas-mcp | per-tick timestamp | infra_health_logs |
> 275	| `audit-4cs.sh` (existente) | `0 12 * * 1` (Seg 09:00 BRT) | Já cobre projeto inteiro; capturará canvas KPIs | weekly snapshot | infra_health_logs |
> 276	
> 277	> All cron jobs must be idempotent — re-running on the same data must produce the same result.
> 278	
> 279	**Crons NÃO necessários (anti-patterns evitados):**
> 280	- Não há cron de "save canvas a cada N min" — auto-save event-driven é suficiente
> 281	- Não há cron de "regenerate embeddings" — trigger pg_net cobre INSERT; UPDATE de stability é separado

> 486	## 📐 7. FEATURE SPECIFICATIONS
> 487	
> 488	### 7.1 Feature: Viral Miner Dashboard
> 489	
> 490	**Story:** As a Creator, I want to see what's trending in my niche right now so I can capitalize on momentum.
> 491	
> 492	**Acceptance Criteria:**
> 493	- ✅ Dashboard loads in < 2s with at least 20 trends
> 494	- ✅ Filters: platform (multi-select), niche (multi-select), recency (last 1h/6h/24h/7d), score range
> 495	- ✅ Each trend card shows: thumbnail, title, platform, niche, score (0-100), velocity arrow, engagement metrics, ETA-to-peak
> 496	- ✅ Click trend → opens detail view with sample posts, related hashtags, suggested products (affiliate cross-match)
> 497	- ✅ "Use this trend" CTA → routes to Video Factory with prefilled brief
> 498	- ✅ Auto-refresh every 10 min OR manual refresh button
> 499	- ✅ Save trend to project (creates `mcorch_node` of type `trend`)
> 500	- ✅ Empty state: "Configure your niches in Settings to see trends"
> 501	
> 502	**Edge Cases:**

> 507	### 7.2 Feature: Canvas Studio — Node Generation
> 508	
> 509	**Story:** As a Creator, I want to generate images and videos through a visual workflow so I can iterate quickly and save my process.
> 510	
> 511	**Acceptance Criteria:**
> 512	- ✅ Drag a node type from toolbar OR right-click canvas → "Add node"
> 513	- ✅ Node config panel opens on right with model-specific parameters
> 514	- ✅ Cost preview updates as parameters change ("This will cost X credits")
> 515	- ✅ If credits insufficient → show inline upgrade CTA, don't allow Run
> 516	- ✅ Run button is disabled if config invalid (missing prompt, invalid params)
> 517	- ✅ During generation: loading spinner on node, status in status bar
> 518	- ✅ On success: preview shown in node, output handle becomes connectable
> 519	- ✅ On failure: error message in node, retry button, no credits charged
> 520	- ✅ Save as Recipe: prompts for name, tags, public/private, thumbnail auto-generated
> 521	- ✅ Recipe execution: 1-click to run full workflow with current inputs
> 522	
> 523	**Edge Cases:**
> 524	- Generation timeout (> 5 min) → cancel, refund credits, show error
> 525	- Model temporarily unavailable → suggest alternative model
> 526	- Generated content fails content moderation → flag, don't store, no credit refund
> 527	- Concurrent generations on same node → block, show "Generation in progress"
> 528

> 50	
> 51	## ONDA C3 — Tipos de nó cinematográficos (~30 créditos)
> 52	
> 53	| # | Nó | Função | Custo (créditos do usuário) |
> 54	|---|----|--------|------------------------------|
> 55	| 1 | **Character** | Substitui GenerateImage. Specs de pose (close-up, perfil, corpo inteiro). FLUX Pro/Dev/SDXL. | 12 |
> 56	| 2 | **Scene Frame** | Personagem (opcional) + cenário. Herda paleta/atmosfera do projeto. | 14 |
> 57	| 3 | **Style Reference** | Define mood visual para downstream. | 4 |
> 58	| 4 | **Compose** | Combina 2 imagens (ex: char + cenário). | 10 |

> 61	| 7 | **Export** | Combina vídeos das lanes em sequência final. Outputs 9:16, 16:9, 1:1. | 5 |

> 104	## Decisões técnicas (respostas Lovable, 2026-05-13)
> 105	
> 106	**1. Lanes no React Flow** → abordagem **híbrida**: overlay visual (SVG/CSS,
> 107	não nodes) + `snapToGrid` para colunas + lane derivada de `node.position.y`
> 108	em runtime. Evita bugs de parent-node do React Flow.
> 109	
> 110	**2. Cloud Storage** → **Supabase Storage** nativo (já no stack via Lovable
> 111	Cloud). Bucket privado `canvas-outputs`, RLS por workspace, path
> 112	`{workspace_id}/{project_id}/{node_id}.png`, URL assinada com TTL 7 dias.

> 116	como alternativa. Async obrigatório (2-5 min) com tabela `canvas_jobs`. Em C3
> 117	entra como mock; integração real em C4.

> 119	**4. Tempo C2** → 1 sessão de trabalho (~3-4 trocas no chat), 22-28 créditos
> 120	Lovable se mantido o escopo travado.

> 123	- Character Consistency real (FLUX Pulid): caro em créditos do usuário
> 124	  (~25/render). Começar por consistência via prompt antes de IP-Adapter.

> 126	  3 painéis "ricos" (Character, SceneFrame, I2V) + 4 compactos.
> 127	- Export node combinando vídeos: ffmpeg **não roda no Cloudflare Worker**
> 128	  (sem `child_process`). Usar Replicate `ffmpeg-api` ou serviço externo.

> 292	async function generateReplicate(apiKey: string, body: ExecuteRequest) {
> 293	  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("Replicate API key not configured");
> 294	
> 295	  const modelMap: Record<string, string> = {
> 296	    "flux-1.1-pro": "black-forest-labs/flux-1.1-pro",
> 297	    "flux-schnell": "black-forest-labs/flux-schnell",
> 298	    "sdxl": "stability-ai/sdxl:39ed52f2a78e934b3ba6e2a89f5b1c712de7dfea535525255b1aa35c5565e08b",
> 299	  };
> 300	
> 301	  const modelId = modelMap[body.model] || body.model;
> 302	  const input: Record<string, any> = {
> 303	    prompt: body.prompt,
> 304	    ...(body.negative_prompt ? { negative_prompt: body.negative_prompt } : {}),
> 305	    ...(body.parameters?.width ? { width: body.parameters.width } : {}),
> 306	    ...(body.parameters?.height ? { height: body.parameters.height } : {}),
> 307	    ...(body.parameters?.num_inference_steps ? { num_inference_steps: body.parameters.num_inference_steps } : {}),
> 308	    ...(body.parameters?.guidance_scale ? { guidance_scale: body.parameters.guidance_scale } : {}),
> 309	  };
> 310	
> 311	  // Create prediction
> 312	  const createResp = await fetch("https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions", {
> 313	    method: "POST",
> 314	    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
> 315	    body: JSON.stringify({ model: modelId.includes(":") ? undefined : modelId, version: modelId.includes(":") ? modelId.split(":")[1] : undefined, input }),
> 316	  });
> 317	
> 318	  if (!createResp.ok) {
> 319	    const t = await createResp.text();
> 320	    throw new Error(`Replicate error ${createResp.status}: ${t}`);
> 321	  }
> 322	
> 323	  let prediction = await createResp.json();
> 324	
> 325	  // Poll for completion (max 120s)
> 326	  const maxWait = 120_000;
> 327	  const start = Date.now();
> 328	  while (prediction.status !== "succeeded" && prediction.status !== "failed" && Date.now() - start < maxWait) {
> 329	    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000));
> 330	    const pollResp = await fetch(prediction.urls.get, {
> 331	      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` },
> 332	    });
> 333	    prediction = await pollResp.json();
> 334	  }
> 335	
> 336	  if (prediction.status === "failed") {
> 337	    throw new Error(`Replicate failed: ${prediction.error}`);
> 338	  }
> 339	
> 340	  const output = Array.isArray(prediction.output) ? prediction.output[0] : prediction.output;
> 341	  return { url: output || "" };
> 342	}

> 393	  const aspectRatio = body.parameters?.aspect_ratio || SIZE_TO_AR[sizeKey] || "1:1";
> 394	  const resolution = body.parameters?.resolution === "720p" ? "720p" : "1080p";

> 397	  const submitResp = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard`, {

> 411	    }
> 412	    if (submitResp.status === 402) {

> 421	  const submitData = await submitResp.json();
> 422	  const requestId = submitData.request_id || submitData.id;

> 424	
> 425	  // ── Poll until terminal state ──────────────────────────────────────

> 427	  while (Date.now() - started < MAX_POLL_MS) {

> 429	    const statusResp = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/requests/${requestId}/status`, {

> 436	    }
> 437	    const statusData = await statusResp.json();
> 438	    if (statusData.status === "completed") {

> 440	      if (!url) throw new Error("Higgsfield: geração concluída sem URL de saída");

> 175	      .upsert(upsertData, { onConflict: "external_id", ignoreDuplicates: false })
> 176	      .select();
> 177

> 179	      console.error("Upsert error:", upsertErr);
> 180	    }
> 181

> 183	      trends: upserted || trends,
> 184	      source,
> 185	      count: (upserted || trends).length,
> 186	      message: `Fetched ${(upserted || trends).length} trends from ${source}`,
> 187	    }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
> 188	
> 189	  } catch (e) {
> 190	    console.error("fetch-trends error:", e);
> 191	    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error" }), {
> 192	      status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
> 193	    });
> 194	  }

  "content": "# MRD \u2014 Market Requirements Document\n\n**Project:** viralmind\n**Version:** v0.1 | **Date:** 2026-05-14\n**BoK Applied:** BABOK v3 (Strategy Analysis + Elicitation & Collaboration)\n**Status:** Approved\n\n---\n\n## 1. Executive Summary\n\nO criador de conte\u00fado brasileiro de 2026 opera como uma opera\u00e7\u00e3o de m\u00eddia unipessoal: precisa **minerar tend\u00eancias virais** antes que esfriem, **produzir m\u00eddia gerada por IA** em escala, **distribuir** em 9+ plataformas e **converter tr\u00e1fego em receita** via afiliados e an\u00fancios \u2014 tudo isso pulando entre 4-7 ferramentas isoladas que n\u00e3o conversam entre si e cobram assinatura pr\u00f3pria em USD. VIRALmind \u00e9 o **sistema operacional AI-native** que colapsa essa cadeia inteira \u2014 descoberta de tend\u00eancias, produ\u00e7\u00e3o visual nodal, f\u00e1brica de v\u00eddeo, radar de afiliados e comandante de an\u00fancios \u2014 em uma superf\u00edcie auton\u00f4mica \u00fanica, hospedada dentro do ecossistema MCORCH, monetizada via mcoCoins em BRL, com reten\u00e7\u00e3o de contexto via GraphRAG e orquestra\u00e7\u00e3o por agentes BoK. A janela competitiva \u00e9 de 6-12 meses antes que players globais (Adobe, Canva) lancem variantes brasileiras com canvas nodal; MCORCH tem vantagem first-mover BR + arquitetura soberana j\u00e1 operacional (Edge Functions, Knowledge Mesh, mcoCoins gatekeeper at\u00f4mico, React 18 + xyflow + Zustand).\n\n---\n\n## 2. Market Problem Statement\n\n### 2.1 Current State\n\nCreators, ag\u00eancias e marketers de performance que monetizam conte\u00fado hoje sofrem com **fragmenta\u00e7\u00e3o operacional total**:\n\n1. **Descoberta de tend\u00eancias \u00e9 manual e tardia** \u2014 rolam feeds do TikTok/YouTube/Instagram \u00e0 m\u00e3o; quando identificam um padr\u00e3o viral, o pico j\u00e1 passou. N\u00e3o h\u00e1 scoring objetivo de velocidade/engajamento por nicho.\n2. **Produ\u00e7\u00e3o exige malabarismo de ferramentas** \u2014 ChatGPT para roteiro, Midjourney/FLUX para imagem, Runway/Kling para v\u00eddeo, ElevenLabs para voz, Canva para composi\u00e7\u00e3o. Cada handoff \u00e9 download+upload+re-prompt manual.\n3. **Monetiza\u00e7\u00e3o \u00e9 desconectada da produ\u00e7\u00e3o** \u2014 links de afiliado s\u00e3o gerados em planilhas, rastreados sem atribui\u00e7\u00e3o ao conte\u00fado espec\u00edfico que converteu; campanhas pagas vivem em outro silo (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads).\n4. **Custo de assinaturas empilhadas** \u2014 o creator BR m\u00e9dio paga R$ 420+/m\u00eas em SaaS criativo, em USD, sem unifica\u00e7\u00e3o de gasto.\n5. **Zero mem\u00f3ria entre sess\u00f5es** \u2014 nenhuma ferramenta ret\u00e9m contexto criativo; cada projeto recome\u00e7a do zero.\n\n### 2.2 Root Cause Analysis\n\nA ind\u00fastria de IA generativa \u00e9 **fragmentada por design** \u2014 cada provedor (OpenAI, Black Forest Labs, Replicate, Higgsfield, Google) opera silos com APIs pr\u00f3prias. As plataformas que tentam unificar (Magnific/Freepik, Martini.art, Krea) o fazem em **nuvens fechadas**, capturando prompts, gera\u00e7\u00f5es e padr\u00f5es criativos como ativo propriet\u00e1rio e cobrando em USD. O criador paga assinatura **e** cede telemetria criativa. No eixo de descoberta+monetiza\u00e7\u00e3o, ferramentas de trend intelligence (vidIQ, Exploding Topics) e de afiliados/an\u00fancios s\u00e3o produtos completamente separados, sem ponte para a produ\u00e7\u00e3o. **N\u00e3o existe um sistema operacional integrado, soberano e precificado em BRL** que feche o loop tend\u00eancia \u2192 produ\u00e7\u00e3o \u2192 distribui\u00e7\u00e3o \u2192 receita.\n\n### 2.3 Desired State\n\nUm sistema operacional de conte\u00fado dentro do ecossistema MCORCH onde:\n1. O **Viral Miner** entrega tend\u00eancias ranqueadas por nicho, plataforma e viral_score, mineradas continuamente de fontes externas.\n2. O **Canvas Studio** \u00e9 um espa\u00e7o nodal infinito onde o criador encadeia gera\u00e7\u00e3o de imagem/v\u00eddeo de m\u00faltiplos provedores, com custo transparente em mcoCoins e Receitas reutiliz\u00e1veis.\n3. A **Video Factory** transforma um brief (ou uma tend\u00eancia) em v\u00eddeo pronto-para-publicar com roteiro, locu\u00e7\u00e3o e legendas autom\u00e1ticos.\n4. O **Affiliate Radar** descobre produtos de alta comiss\u00e3o por nicho e gera links rastre\u00e1veis com UTM, atribuindo receita ao conte\u00fado espec\u00edfico.\n5. O **Ads Commander** lan\u00e7a e otimiza campanhas pagas a partir de um brief em linguagem natural.\n6. Tudo consome **mcoCoins** (ledger MCORCH j\u00e1 existente, em BRL), sob **LGPD soberana** (dados no Supabase do pr\u00f3prio ecossistema), com o **AIOS (mega-brain)** atuando como co-piloto auton\u00f4mico.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Target Market Segments\n\n| Segment | Description | Size Estimate | Urgency | Accessibility |\n|---------|-------------|---------------|---------|---------------|\n| Primary | Solo creators e micro-ag\u00eancias BR que monetizam via afiliados + sponsorships (persona \"Carolina\" + \"Rafael\") | 80-300 usu\u00e1rios nos primeiros 6 meses; ~250k creators monetizando no BR | High | Direta \u2014 onboarding via dashboard MCORCH + comunidade |\n| Secondary | Performance marketers / growth leads de marcas D2C que gerenciam ad spend (persona \"Marina\") | 30-80 contas Pro/Agency no Y2 | Medium | Via Stripe + sales-assisted; entram pelo Ads Commander |\n| Tertiary | Marcas Enterprise (CPG/luxo) buscando reduzir lock-in de ag\u00eancia | 5-15 contas Enterprise no Y2 | Low | Custom + dedicated success; bloqueado por SLA + multiplayer |\n\n### 3.1 TAM / SAM / SOM\n\n| Metric | Value | Basis |\n|--------|-------|-------|\n| TAM (Total Addressable Market) | R$ 3.5B/ano BR | Mercado BR de SaaS criativo + trend intelligence + ad tooling para creators e ag\u00eancias (estimativa composta Sebrae 2025 + ABRADi + relat\u00f3rios creator economy) |\n| SAM (Serviceable Addressable Market) | R$ 420M/ano BR | Subset que paga 200+/m\u00eas por ferramentas de produ\u00e7\u00e3o/monetiza\u00e7\u00e3o (\u2248 250k creators monetizando \u00d7 R$ 1.680/ano m\u00e9dio) |\n| SOM (Serviceable Obtainable Market) | R$ 14M ARR em 24 meses | ~3,3% do SAM via canal direto MCORCH + afiliados (\u2248 5k usu\u00e1rios pagantes \u00d7 R$ 2.800/ano em assinatura + mcoCoins) \u2014 alinhado \u00e0 meta operacional do PRD (10k MAU / 5k pagantes / US$ 200k MRR no M\u00eas 12) |\n\n---\n\n## 4. Market Opportunity & Timing\n\nQuatro vetores convergem em 2026:\n\n1. **Maturidade dos modelos** \u2014 FLUX 1.1 Pro, DALL\u00b7E 3 / GPT-Image-1, Higgsfield Soul, Kling e Veo 3 chegaram a qualidade comercial-ready; APIs est\u00e1veis via OpenAI/Replicate/OpenRouter/Higgsfield.\n2. **Regula\u00e7\u00e3o LGPD madura** \u2014 a ANPD intensificou fiscaliza\u00e7\u00e3o sobre uso de dados em treinamento de IA; creators e marcas BR passam a exigir soberania de dados como crit\u00e9rio de compra.\n3. **Satura\u00e7\u00e3o de assinaturas** \u2014 fadiga de SaaS empilhado em USD; apetite alt\u00edssimo por consolida\u00e7\u00e3o e por pre\u00e7o em BRL.\n4. **Economia de afiliados em alta no BR** \u2014 Mercado Livre, Hotmart, Monetizze e Amazon Associates BR tornaram a renda de afiliado mainstream para creators; falta a ponte produ\u00e7\u00e3o\u2194monetiza\u00e7\u00e3o.\n\nA janela competitiva \u00e9 de **6-12 meses** antes que Adobe/Canva lancem canvas nodal localizado. Executive Summary\n\nVIRALmind transforma o MCORCH de \"ecossistema de pipeline social aut\u00f4nomo\" em **sistema operacional de conte\u00fado AI-native** ao adicionar cinco m\u00f3dulos integrados \u2014 Viral Miner, Canvas Studio, Video Factory, Affiliate Radar e Ads Commander \u2014 que fecham o loop tend\u00eancia \u2192 produ\u00e7\u00e3o \u2192 distribui\u00e7\u00e3o \u2192 receita. O modelo de neg\u00f3cio capitaliza a infraestrutura MCORCH j\u00e1 existente (Edge Functions, mcoCoins gatekeeper at\u00f4mico, Supabase RLS, Knowledge Mesh) com **CapEx de desenvolvimento \u2248 R$ 0** (Sovereign + executores Claude/Antigravity) e **OpEx adicional incremental** (APIs de modelos via OpenAI/Replicate/OpenRouter/Higgsfield, escalando com volume). Receita projetada: **R$ 14M ARR em 24 meses** pelo canal direto, com payback do desenvolvimento em 4-6 meses. A v1 (Sprints 1-3 + Sprint 4.1) entrega Viral Miner + Canvas Studio com `vm_*` em produ\u00e7\u00e3o; este BRD \u00e9 o caso de neg\u00f3cio da vis\u00e3o completa e o roadmap de evolu\u00e7\u00e3o.\n\n---\n\n## 2. desenvolvimento \u2248 R$ 0) |\n\n---\n\n## 6. mcoCoins Economics\n\n> Custos can\u00f4nicos do cat\u00e1logo `CREDIT_COSTS` da Edge Function `canvas-execute` (shipped). VIRALmind consome o ledger mcoCoins do MCORCH (`profiles.mco_balance` via `deduct_mco_coins` RPC) \u2014 n\u00e3o h\u00e1 ledger separado. Mapeamento de planos segue os tiers MCORCH.\n\n| Operation | Coins/Run | Plan Tier Mapping | Monthly Volume (est. Y1 mid) | Monthly Revenue (est.) |\n|-----------|-----------|-------------------|-----------------------------|----------------------|\n| Generate image \u2014 `replicate/flux-schnell` | 3 | Starter(500) \u00b7 Pro(2000) \u00b7 Enterprise(10k) | 6.000 gera\u00e7\u00f5es/MAU | \u2014 (consome quota) |\n| Generate image \u2014 `replicate/sdxl` | 4 | \u2014 | 4.000 gera\u00e7\u00f5es/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Generate image \u2014 `replicate/flux-1.1-pro` | 12 | \u2014 | 5.000 gera\u00e7\u00f5es/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Generate image \u2014 `openai/dall-e-3` \u00b7 `openrouter/dall-e-3` | 15 | \u2014 | 3.000 gera\u00e7\u00f5es/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Generate image \u2014 `openai/gpt-image-1` | 18 | \u2014 | 1.500 gera\u00e7\u00f5es/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Generate image \u2014 `higgsfield/generate` (Soul) | 20 | \u2014 | 800 gera\u00e7\u00f5es/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Upscale 2x / 4x | 8 / 20 | \u2014 | 1.200 / 300 ops/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Inpaint | 6 | \u2014 | 900 ops/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Style transfer | 10 | \u2014 | 700 ops/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Remove background | 3 | \u2014 | 1.000 ops/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Generate video (roadmap \u2014 Video Factory / Canvas I2V) | 50-200 | \u2014 | 600 v\u00eddeos/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Ads campaign deploy (roadmap \u2014 Ads Commander) | 25 | \u2014 | 200 deploys/MAU | \u2014 |\n| Default (opera\u00e7\u00e3o sem custo mapeado) | 10 | \u2014 | \u2014 | \u2014 |\n| Trend mining (`fetch-trends`) \u00b7 Affiliate link generation | 0 | Incluso em todos os planos | ilimitado | \u2014 |\n\n**Top-up mcoCoins (refer\u00eancia MCORCH):** pacotes adicionais acima da quota do plano, precificados em BRL.\n**Nota de pricing:** o `03-prd.md` (\u00a78) define tiers standalone do VIRALmind (Free/Creator/Pro/Agency/Enterprise em USD). Constraints & Assumptions\n\n### Constraints\n- **C-001:** Limite semanal de contexto dos executores (Claude/Antigravity) for\u00e7a entrega em phases \u2014 n\u00e3o \u00e9 poss\u00edvel os 5 m\u00f3dulos num \u00fanico sprint.\n- **C-002:** Bundle do frontend deve permanecer enxuto (Lighthouse) \u2014 xyflow + componentes de canvas exigem code-splitting por rota lazy.\n- **C-003:** Edge Functions t\u00eam timeout de ~60s \u2014 gera\u00e7\u00e3o de v\u00eddeo (longa) exige padr\u00e3o webhook/queue ass\u00edncrono, n\u00e3o chamada s\u00edncrona.\n- **C-004:** APIs externas (Apify, RapidAPI, OpenAI, Replicate, Higgsfield) t\u00eam rate limits que limitam concorr\u00eancia em hor\u00e1rios de pico.\n- **C-005:** LGPD impede armazenar prompt de menores sem consentimento \u2014 gate de signup do MCORCH j\u00e1 filtra.\n- **C-006:** VIRALmind compartilha o ledger mcoCoins do MCORCH \u2014 n\u00e3o pode introduzir um sistema de cr\u00e9dito paralelo (decis\u00e3o arquitet\u00f4nica MCORCH).\n\n### Assumptions\n- **A-001:** Usu\u00e1rios atuais do MCORCH s\u00e3o receptivos aos m\u00f3dulos VIRALmind (validado pelo Sovereign Zero como piloto).\n- **A-002:** OpenAI, Replicate, OpenRouter e Higgsfield mant\u00eam disponibilidade de modelos nos pr\u00f3ximos 12 meses.\n- **A-003:** Os 30 cr\u00e9ditos Higgsfield j\u00e1 pagos pelo Sovereign (> R$ 130) ficam utiliz\u00e1veis assim que o endpoint Platform API for validado (Canvas Phase 4.2).\n- **A-004:** Stripe live keys ser\u00e3o configuradas antes do onboarding do primeiro cliente externo (intencionalmente em sandbox enquanto o Sovereign valida como Usu\u00e1rio Zero).\n- **A-005:** Sovereign mant\u00e9m autoridade decis\u00f3ria final em OTDs e prioriza\u00e7\u00e3o de m\u00f3dulos/phases.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Interface Requirements\n\n### 4.1 UI \u2192 Hook \u2192 Edge Function Contract\n\n**Canvas Studio \u2014 gera\u00e7\u00e3o de imagem:**\n```\n[Component: CanvasEditorPage / node card]\n  \u2193 (onExecute \u2192 calls hook)\n[Hook: useCanvasExecute]\n  \u2193 (supabase.functions.invoke + JWT)\n[Edge Function: canvas-execute]\n  \u2193 (deduct_mco_coins RPC)\n[DB: profiles.mco_balance]\n  \u2193 (calls)\n[External API: OpenAI | Replicate | OpenRouter | Higgsfield]\n  \u2193 (image bytes / URL)\n[Storage: bucket canvas-assets] + [DB: vm_canvas_executions + vm_canvas_assets]\n  \u2193 (TanStack Query invalidation)\n[UI: node output renders + StatusBar updates mco_balance]\n```\n\n**Viral Miner \u2014 minera\u00e7\u00e3o de tend\u00eancias:**\n```\n[Component: ViralMinerPage]\n  \u2193 (onMineTrends \u2192 calls hook)\n[Hook: useFetchTrends]\n  \u2193 (supabase.functions.invoke + JWT)\n[Edge Function: fetch-trends]\n  \u2193 (Apify \u2192 RapidAPI \u2192 cache fallback)\n[External API: Apify actors | RapidAPI tiktok-scraper7]\n  \u2193 (upsert by external_id)\n[DB: vm_trends]\n  \u2193 (TanStack Query invalidation of useViralTrends)\n[UI: trend card grid refreshes]\n```\n\n### 4.2 External API Contracts\n\n#### `POST /functions/v1/canvas-execute` *(shipped)*\n\n**Auth:** Bearer JWT (user scope)\n**Request:**\n```typescript\n{\n  project_id: string;          // FK vm_canvas_projects.id\n  node_id: string;             // xyflow node id\n  node_type: string;           // generate_image | upscale | inpaint | style_transfer | ...\n  provider: string;            // openai | replicate | openrouter | higgsfield\n  model: string;               // dall-e-3 | flux-1.1-pro | sdxl | flux-schnell | gpt-image-1 | generate\n  prompt: string;\n  negative_prompt?: string;\n  parameters?: Record<string, any>;   // size, quality, style, width, height, aspect_ratio, resolution...\n  input_asset_url?: string;\n}\n```\n**Response (200):**\n```typescript\n{\n  execution_id: string;\n  status: 'success' | 'failed';\n  output_url: string | null;\n  asset_id: string | null;\n  credits_charged: number;     // 0 em falha\n  credits_remaining: number;\n  error?: string;\n}\n```\n**Error codes:**\n| Code | Condition |\n|------|-----------|\n| 401 | Missing `Authorization` header ou JWT inv\u00e1lido |\n| 400 | `project_id`, `node_id` ou `prompt` ausentes |\n| 402 | Saldo de mcoCoins insuficiente (`required` + `balance` no body) |\n| 500 | Erro interno (insert de execu\u00e7\u00e3o falhou / erro inesperado) |\n\n> Nota: na v1 atual, erro de provedor n\u00e3o retorna HTTP 5xx \u2014 a execu\u00e7\u00e3o \u00e9 gravada com `status='failed'` e `error` no body 200. Endurecer isso (refund + telemetria) \u00e9 item de FMEA \u2014 ver `08-quality-metrics.md`.\n\n#### `POST /functions/v1/fetch-trends` *(shipped)*\n\n**Auth:** Bearer JWT (user scope)\n**Request:**\n```typescript\n{\n  platform?: string;   // default 'tiktok'\n  niche?: string;      // default 'tech' (slug de vm_niches)\n  limit?: number;      // default 20, max 50\n  source?: 'apify' | 'rapidapi' | 'mock';   // default 'apify'\n}\n```\n**Response (200):**\n```typescript\n{\n  trends: VmTrend[];\n  source: 'apify' | 'rapidapi' | 'cache';\n  count: number;\n  message?: string;\n}\n```\n**Error codes:**\n| Code | Condition |\n|------|-----------|\n| 401 | Missing `Authorization` header ou JWT inv\u00e1lido |\n| 500 | `APIFY_TOKENS` n\u00e3o configurado / erro inesperado |\n\n> Comportamento de fallback: se Apify falhar ou retornar 0 itens, tenta RapidAPI; se ambos falharem, retorna trends em cache de `vm_trends` (`source: 'cache'`).\n\n---\n\n## 5. O corpo deste documento descreve o schema **as-built** em produ\u00e7\u00e3o (10 tabelas `vm_*` + 6 enums). O \u00a78 Appendix documenta o delta aspiracional (tabelas ainda n\u00e3o constru\u00eddas) referenciando `schema-reference.sql`.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Conceptual Data Model\n\n```\n[auth.users] \u2500\u2500(1:N)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_user_trends] \u2500\u2500(N:1)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_trends] \u2500\u2500(N:1)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_niches]\n      \u2502                                                   \u2502\n      \u2502                                            (embedding 1536d \u2014 aspiracional, sem HNSW)\n      \u2502\n      \u251c\u2500\u2500(1:N)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_canvas_projects] \u2500\u2500(1:N)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_canvas_executions] \u2500\u2500(N:1)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_canvas_assets]\n      \u2502                  \u2502                               \u2502\n      \u2502                  \u2514\u2500\u2500(1:N)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_canvas_assets]   \u2514\u2500\u2500 status machine (pending\u2192\u2026\u2192success/failed)\n      \u2502\n      \u251c\u2500\u2500(1:N)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_canvas_recipes]   (user_id NULL = receita oficial/p\u00fablica)\n      \u2502\n      \u251c\u2500\u2500(1:N)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_affiliate_links] \u2500\u2500(N:1)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_affiliate_products] \u2500\u2500(N:1)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 (niches via TEXT[])\n      \u2502                  \u2502\n      \u2502                  \u2514\u2500\u2500(1:N)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [vm_affiliate_clicks]\n      \u2502\n      \u2514\u2500\u2500(1:1)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [profiles] (mco_balance)   \u25c0\u2500\u2500 d\u00e9bito at\u00f4mico via deduct_mco_coins RPC\n\n[vm_trends / vm_canvas_recipes / vm_affiliate_products] \u2500\u2500(observation/seal)\u2500\u2500\u25b6 [mcorch_nodes]\n```\n\n**Entities:**\n- **vm_niches:** Cat\u00e1logo curado de 18 nichos (compartilhado, read-only para usu\u00e1rios). Base do targeting de tend\u00eancias e conte\u00fado.\n- **vm_trends:** Pool global de tend\u00eancias virais mineradas de plataformas externas. Compartilhado entre todos os usu\u00e1rios.\n- **vm_user_trends:** Rela\u00e7\u00e3o per-user com tend\u00eancias salvas/favoritadas.\n- **vm_canvas_projects:** Pipelines visuais nodais do usu\u00e1rio; `graph` jsonb embute n\u00f3s, edges, `pipelineMode`, `lanes`, `styleSettings`.\n- **vm_canvas_assets:** Cada asset (imagem/v\u00eddeo/\u00e1udio/documento) gerado dentro do canvas.\n- **vm_canvas_executions:** Trilha de auditoria de cada execu\u00e7\u00e3o de n\u00f3, com status machine.\n- **vm_canvas_recipes:** Blueprints de grafo reutiliz\u00e1veis \u2014 `user_id` NULL para receitas oficiais; `is_public` para compartilhadas.\n- **vm_affiliate_products:** Cat\u00e1logo global de ofertas de afiliados (compartilhado, read-only para usu\u00e1rios).\n- **vm_affiliate_links:** Links de afiliado per-user com short_code, UTM e contadores de performance.\n- **vm_affiliate_clicks:** Log de eventos de clique para atribui\u00e7\u00e3o de receita.\n- **mcorch_nodes (extension):** N\u00f3s de observa\u00e7\u00e3o/seal para entidades VIRALmind significativas (ver \u00a74).\n\n---\n\n## 2.
