Supabase Physical Schema Stubs\n\nO SQL completo est\u00e1 nas 4 migrations `supabase/migrations/20260514040000`-`20260514040300`. Resumo dos artefatos f\u00edsicos cr\u00edticos:\n\n```sql\n-- \u2500\u2500 \u00cdndices em produ\u00e7\u00e3o (todos B-tree) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_trends_platform        ON vm_trends(platform);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_trends_niche           ON vm_trends(niche);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_trends_viral_score     ON vm_trends(viral_score DESC);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_trends_is_active       ON vm_trends(is_active) WHERE is_active = TRUE;\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_trends_detected_at     ON vm_trends(detected_at DESC);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_user_trends_user       ON vm_user_trends(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_canvas_projects_user   ON vm_canvas_projects(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_canvas_assets_user     ON vm_canvas_assets(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_canvas_assets_project  ON vm_canvas_assets(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_canvas_executions_project ON vm_canvas_executions(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_canvas_executions_status  ON vm_canvas_executions(status);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_aff_products_network   ON vm_affiliate_products(network);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_aff_products_score     ON vm_affiliate_products(profitability_score DESC);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_aff_links_user         ON vm_affiliate_links(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_aff_links_short        ON vm_affiliate_links(short_code);\nCREATE INDEX idx_vm_aff_clicks_link        ON vm_affiliate_clicks(affiliate_link_id);\n\n-- \u26a0\ufe0f AUSENTE: nenhum \u00edndice HNSW sobre vm_trends.embedding nem\n--    vm_affiliate_products.embedding. As colunas existem mas n\u00e3o s\u00e3o\n--    pesquis\u00e1veis por similaridade hoje. Ver \u00a76 + OTD em 00-index.md.\n\n-- \u2500\u2500 Updated-at trigger (fun\u00e7\u00e3o pr\u00f3pria do VIRALmind) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nCREATE FUNCTION vm_update_updated_at() RETURNS TRIGGER ...;  -- N\u00c3O \u00e9 a update_updated_at_column() do MCORCH\nCREATE TRIGGER vm_trends_updated_at           BEFORE UPDATE ON vm_trends ...;\nCREATE TRIGGER vm_canvas_projects_updated_at  BEFORE UPDATE ON vm_canvas_projects ...;\nCREATE TRIGGER vm_canvas_recipes_updated_at   BEFORE UPDATE ON vm_canvas_recipes ...;\nCREATE TRIGGER vm_aff_links_updated_at        BEFORE UPDATE ON vm_affiliate_links ...;\n\n-- \u2500\u2500 Storage bucket \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nINSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)\nVALUES ('canvas-assets','canvas-assets', TRUE, 52428800, ARRAY['image/png',...,'audio/wav']);\n-- \u26a0\ufe0f Bucket \u00e9 P\u00daBLICO (public=TRUE) \u2014 diverge da pol\u00edtica MCORCH de buckets privados\n--    com signed URLs. Documentado como OTD em 00-index.md.\n```\n\n> **Diferen\u00e7as de conven\u00e7\u00e3o vs MCORCH:** (1) fun\u00e7\u00e3o `vm_update_updated_at()` pr\u00f3pria em vez de `update_updated_at_column()`; (2) sem `trg_*_embed_on_insert` nas tabelas `vm_*` \u2014 embeddings n\u00e3o s\u00e3o disparados automaticamente; (3) bucket p\u00fablico em vez de privado+signed URL; (4) embeddings `vector(1536)` em vez de `vector(768)`. Nenhuma dessas tabelas tem coluna `stability_score`/FSRS \u2014 FSRS vive apenas em `mcorch_nodes`.\n\n---\n\n## 4. GraphRAG Knowledge Nodes\n\nA integra\u00e7\u00e3o de VIRALmind com o Knowledge Mesh acontece **via `mcorch_nodes`** (n\u00e3o via embeddings nas tabelas `vm_*`, que hoje s\u00e3o aspiracionais \u2014 ver \u00a76). Os n\u00f3s de observa\u00e7\u00e3o/seal s\u00e3o inseridos explicitamente.\n\n### Node Types Introduced\n\n| node_type | Title Pattern | Content Fields | Embedding Source |\n|-----------|--------------|----------------|-----------------|\n| `viral_trend` | `Trend: <trend.title> @ <platform>` | t\u00edtulo + nicho + hashtags + viral_score | concatena\u00e7\u00e3o \u2192 `embed-mcorch-node` |\n| `canvas_recipe` | `Recipe: <recipe.name>` | nome + descri\u00e7\u00e3o + resumo do grafo | concatena\u00e7\u00e3o \u2192 `embed-mcorch-node` |\n| `canvas_milestone` | `Canvas milestone: <project> @ <date>` | t\u00edtulo + a\u00e7\u00f5es executadas | texto de resumo |\n| `affiliate_product` | `Affiliate product: <name> (<network>)` | nome + nichos + comiss\u00e3o + profitability_score | concatena\u00e7\u00e3o |\n| `documentation_suite` (existing) | `bok-scribe-seal-viralmind-v1` | s\u00edntese da su\u00edte BoK (esta fam\u00edlia de docs) | resumo completo do BoK |\n\n### Edge Types Introduced\n\n| Edge relationship | Source node_type | Target node_type | Metadata |\n|-------------------|-----------------|-----------------|----------|\n| `INSPIRED_BY` | `canvas_recipe` | `viral_trend` | `niche`, `similarity_score` (quando a receita deriva de uma tend\u00eancia) |\n| `MONETIZED_BY` | `canvas_milestone` | `affiliate_product` | `link_short_code` |\n| `DERIVES_FROM` | `documentation_suite` | `documentation_suite` | `parent: 'bok-scribe-seal-conteudo-v2-v1'` (VIRALmind v1 \u2194 Conte\u00fado v2 converg\u00eancia) |\n\n### Embedding Trigger\n\nDiferente do padr\u00e3o MCORCH (onde `trg_mcorch_embed_on_insert` cobre todo INSERT em `mcorch_nodes`), as tabelas `vm_*` **n\u00e3o t\u00eam trigger de embedding**. Os n\u00f3s VIRALmind s\u00e3o inseridos explicitamente em `mcorch_nodes` pelas Edge Functions / scripts, e o embedding \u00e9 ent\u00e3o disparado pelo trigger existente do `mcorch_nodes`:\n\n```typescript\n// Inser\u00e7\u00e3o expl\u00edcita (ex.: ao salvar uma Receita significativa):\nawait supabase.from('mcorch_nodes').insert({\n  node_type: 'canvas_recipe',\n  name: `Recipe: ${recipe.name}`,\n  content: `${recipe.name} ${recipe.description} ${JSON.stringify(recipe.graph).slice(0, 2000)}`,\n  user_id: user.id,\n  project_id: 'viralmind',\n  stability_score: 0.6,\n  metadata: { recipe_id: recipe.id, category: recipe.category },\n})\n// embedding (768d) disparado por trg_mcorch_embed_on_insert do mcorch_nodes\n```\n\n### FSRS-6 Parameters\n\n| Field | Initial Value | Decay Rule |\n|-------|--------------|------------|\n| `stability_score` (n\u00f3s `viral_trend`) | `0.4` | Tend\u00eancias decaem r\u00e1pido (vida \u00fatil curta); decai per migration `20260425190000` |\n| `stability_score` (n\u00f3s `canvas_recipe`) | `0.6` | Sobe com `uses_count`; receita reutilizada \u00e9 conhecimento est\u00e1vel |\n| `stability_score` (n\u00f3 `documentation_suite` seal) | `0.85` | Paridade com os seals `mcorch-constellation` e `conteudo-v2` |\n| `revenue_impact` (n\u00f3 seal) | derivado da proje\u00e7\u00e3o de ROI do `02-brd.md` | Atualizado quando a receita de afiliados real for instrumentada |\n\n> Nota: as tabelas `vm_*` **n\u00e3o** t\u00eam coluna `stability_score` \u2014 FSRS-6 aplica-se apenas aos n\u00f3s espelhados em `mcorch_nodes`.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Tenant Isolation Map\n\n| Table | `user_id` scope | `project_id` scope | System / shared rows |\n|-------|----------------|-------------------|----------------------|\n| `vm_niches` | \u2014 | \u2014 | \u2705 Cat\u00e1logo compartilhado \u2014 read-all; service-role write |\n| `vm_trends` | \u2014 | \u2014 | \u2705 Pool compartilhado \u2014 read-all (authenticated); service-role write |\n| `vm_user_trends` | \u2705 Required | \u2014 | No \u2014 `auth.uid() = user_id` (ALL) |\n| `vm_canvas_projects` | \u2705 Required | \u2014 | No \u2014 `auth.uid() = user_id` (ALL) |\n| `vm_canvas_assets` | \u2705 Required | Optional (FK SET NULL) | No \u2014 `auth.uid() = user_id` (ALL) |\n| `vm_canvas_executions` | \u2705 Required | Implicit via `project_id` | No \u2014 user l\u00ea pr\u00f3prias; service-role write (ALL) |\n| `vm_canvas_recipes` | Optional (NULL = oficial) | \u2014 | \u2705 Receitas `is_public` ou `is_official` lidas por todos; write s\u00f3 do dono |\n| `vm_affiliate_products` | \u2014 | \u2014 | \u2705 Cat\u00e1logo compartilhado \u2014 read-all (authenticated); service-role write |\n| `vm_affiliate_links` | \u2705 Required | \u2014 | No \u2014 `auth.uid() = user_id` (ALL) |\n| `vm_affiliate_clicks` | \u2705 Required | \u2014 | No \u2014 user l\u00ea pr\u00f3prios; service-role write (ALL) |\n\n**Multi-tenant invariant:** nenhuma linha de `vm_user_trends`, `vm_canvas_*` (projects/assets/executions), `vm_affiliate_links` ou `vm_affiliate_clicks` \u00e9 vis\u00edvel a outro usu\u00e1rio. Os tr\u00eas cat\u00e1logos compartilhados (`vm_niches`, `vm_trends`, `vm_affiliate_products`) s\u00e3o read-only para usu\u00e1rios autenticados e s\u00f3 escritos por `service_role` (via Edge Functions). Todas as 10 tabelas t\u00eam `ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` (31 policies no total).\n\n---\n\n## 6. Data Quality Rules\n\n| Table | Column | Rule | Violation Message (PT-BR) |\n|-------|--------|------|--------------------------|\n| `vm_niches` | `slug` | UNIQUE; lowercase; sem espa\u00e7os | \"Slug de nicho inv\u00e1lido ou duplicado\" |\n| `vm_trends` | `viral_score` | `CHECK (0 \u2264 x \u2264 100)` | \"Score viral fora do intervalo 0-100\" |\n| `vm_trends` | `external_id` | chave de upsert \u2014 n\u00e3o-nulo na ingest\u00e3o por `fetch-trends` | \"Tend\u00eancia sem ID externo \u2014 n\u00e3o pode ser deduplicada\" |\n| `vm_trends` / `vm_affiliate_products` | `embedding` | \u26a0\ufe0f **Deviation conhecida** \u2014 declarado `vector(1536)` (padr\u00e3o MCORCH \u00e9 `vector(768)` via OpenRouter `text-embedding-3-small`); **n\u00e3o h\u00e1 \u00edndice HNSW** \u2192 coluna existe mas n\u00e3o \u00e9 pesquis\u00e1vel por similaridade. Hoje permanece NULL na pr\u00e1tica. | \"Busca sem\u00e2ntica de tend\u00eancias/produtos indispon\u00edvel \u2014 embedding n\u00e3o indexado\" |\n| `vm_canvas_projects` | `graph` | jsonb v\u00e1lido com chaves `nodes`/`edges`; `name` 1-120 chars | \"Grafo de canvas corrompido \u2014 recarregue o projeto\" |\n| `vm_canvas_projects` | `status` | `CHECK (status IN ('active','archived'))` | \"Status de projeto inv\u00e1lido\" |\n| `vm_canvas_executions` | `status` | `CHECK (status IN ('pending','queued','running','success','failed','cancelled'))` | \"Status de execu\u00e7\u00e3o inv\u00e1lido\" |\n| `vm_canvas_assets` | `asset_type` | `CHECK (asset_type IN ('image','video','audio','document'))` | \"Tipo de asset inv\u00e1lido\" |\n| `vm_canvas_assets` | `credits_cost` | `\u2265 0`; sanity cap `\u2264 1000` (valida\u00e7\u00e3o na Edge Function) | \"Custo de gera\u00e7\u00e3o inv\u00e1lido\" |\n| `vm_affiliate_products` | `profitability_score` | `CHECK (0 \u2264 x \u2264 100)` | \"Score de rentabilidade fora do intervalo 0-100\" |\n| `vm_affiliate_products` | `(network, external_id)` | `UNIQUE` | \"Produto de afiliado duplicado para esta rede\" |\n| `vm_affiliate_links` | `short_code` | `UNIQUE`; alfanum\u00e9rico | \"C\u00f3digo de link j\u00e1 em uso\" |\n| `vm_affiliate_links` | `product_id` | FK `ON DELETE RESTRICT` \u2014 produto com links n\u00e3o pode ser removido | \"Produto possui links ativos \u2014 desative-os primeiro\" |\n\n---\n\n## 7. Retention & Archival Policy\n\n| Data | Retention Period | Archival Strategy | Deletion Trigger |\n|------|-----------------|-------------------|-----------------|\n| `vm_niches` | Indefinido | Cat\u00e1logo curado est\u00e1vel | Manual (service-role) |\n| `vm_trends` | Tend\u00eancias ativas indefinido; `is_active=false` quando `expires_at` passa | Backup di\u00e1rio Supabase | Cleanup cron de trends stale (roadmap) |\n| `vm_user_trends` | Indefinido enquanto user ativo | Backup di\u00e1rio | `ON DELETE CASCADE` (user ou trend) |\n| `vm_canvas_projects` ativos | Indefinido enquanto user ativo | Backup di\u00e1rio | User soft-delete (`status='archived'`) ou `delete_account()` |\n| `vm_canvas_assets` | Indefinido; sobrevive ao projeto (`project_id` SET NULL) | Bucket `canvas-assets` (p\u00fablico) | `ON DELETE CASCADE` (user) \u2014 cleanup de assets \u00f3rf\u00e3os \u00e9 roadmap |\n| `vm_canvas_executions` | Indefinido (trilha de auditoria) | Backup di\u00e1rio | `ON DELETE CASCADE` (project ou user) |\n| `vm_canvas_recipes` | Indefinido | Receitas oficiais (`user_id` NULL) s\u00e3o permanentes | `user_id` SET NULL ao deletar dono (receita p\u00fablica sobrevive) |\n| `vm_affiliate_products` | Indefinido; `is_active=false` quando descontinuado | Cat\u00e1logo compartilhado | Manual (service-role) |\n| `vm_affiliate_links` | Indefinido enquanto user ativo | Backup di\u00e1rio | `ON DELETE CASCADE` (user) |\n| `vm_affiliate_clicks` | 90 dias recomendado (trilha de clique de alto volume) | Sem archival | Cleanup cron (roadmap) + `ON DELETE CASCADE` |\n| `mcorch_nodes` (`viral_trend`/`canvas_recipe`/`canvas_milestone`/`affiliate_product`) | Indefinido | Embedded para mesh search | `delete_account()` |\n\n**LGPD compliance:** a Edge Function `data-export` (j\u00e1 em produ\u00e7\u00e3o no MCORCH) deve incluir as tabelas `vm_*` do usu\u00e1rio no payload exportado. O RPC `delete_account()` propaga via `ON DELETE CASCADE` \u2014 todas as FKs de tabelas per-user apontam para `auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`. Verificar a cobertura efetiva das tabelas `vm_*` no `data-export` \u00e9 um item de FMEA (ver `08-quality-metrics.md`).\n\n---\n\n## 8. Appendix \u2014 Aspirational Schema Delta (2026-05-14)\n\nO `03-prd.md` e o `05-sdd.md` descrevem uma vis\u00e3o de 5 m\u00f3dulos. As 10 tabelas `vm_*` em produ\u00e7\u00e3o cobrem **Viral Miner** e **Canvas Studio** integralmente e **Affiliate Radar** parcialmente (schema sem UI/Edge). M\u00f3dulos ainda n\u00e3o constru\u00eddos exigem tabelas adicionais \u2014 documentadas em `docs/bok/viralmind/schema-reference.sql` (schema can\u00f4nico aspiracional, ~2000 linhas), aqui resumidas:\n\n| M\u00f3dulo | Tabelas aspiracionais (n\u00e3o em produ\u00e7\u00e3o) | Status |\n|--------|------------------------------------------|--------|\n| Video Factory | `vm_video_jobs` / `vm_canvas_jobs` (async generation queue), `vm_video_scenes` | \u23f3 N\u00e3o constru\u00eddo \u2014 `vm_canvas_jobs` planejado em Canvas Phase 4.2b |\n| Ads Commander | `vm_ad_campaigns`, `vm_ad_sets`, `vm_ads`, `vm_ad_metrics` | \u23f3 N\u00e3o constru\u00eddo |\n| Credits ledger dedicado | `vm_credit_transactions` (enum `vm_credit_operation` j\u00e1 existe, sem tabela) | \u23f3 N\u00e3o constru\u00eddo \u2014 VIRALmind usa o `mco_transactions` do MCORCH |\n| Workspaces multi-seat | `vm_workspaces`, `vm_workspace_members` | \u23f3 N\u00e3o constru\u00eddo \u2014 VIRALmind usa o tenant model `user_id` do MCORCH |\n| Brand Asset Library (PRD S9) | `vm_brand_assets` | \u23f3 N\u00e3o constru\u00eddo |\n\n**Decis\u00f5es arquitet\u00f4nicas registradas:**\n1. **Namespace `vm_*` mantido.** Rebranding `vm_*` \u2192 `content_canvas_*` (alinhamento com o BoK `conteudo-v2`) n\u00e3o \u00e9 priorit\u00e1rio \u2014 o ganho sem\u00e2ntico n\u00e3o justifica o custo de migration + regenera\u00e7\u00e3o de types. Precedente: `conteudo-v2/06-data-model.md` \u00a78.\n2. **Sem ledger de cr\u00e9dito paralelo.** O enum `vm_credit_operation` existe mas n\u00e3o h\u00e1 tabela `vm_credit_transactions` \u2014 VIRALmind consome o ledger `profiles.mco_balance` + `mco_transactions` do MCORCH via `deduct_mco_coins` RPC. Decis\u00e3o arquitet\u00f4nica do MCORCH (mcoCoins \u00e9 can\u00f4nico e \u00fanico).\n3. **`embedding vector(1536)` + aus\u00eancia de HNSW** registrados como **OTD** em `00-index.md` \u2014 reconciliar para `vector(768)` + criar \u00edndice HNSW antes de ativar busca sem\u00e2ntica de tend\u00eancias/produtos.\n\nA partir desta selagem, este BoK \u00e9 o **roadmap de evolu\u00e7\u00e3o** do schema VIRALmind. Tabelas aspiracionais entram em produ\u00e7\u00e3o via novas migrations conforme cada m\u00f3dulo for constru\u00eddo, cada uma passando por `/security-review` (FMEA-011).\n\n---\n\n_Generated by MCORCH BoK Scribe Agent v1.0.0_\n"

Self-Healing Specifications\n\n### 5.1 Watchdog Telemetry Events\n\nNovos tipos de evento escritos em `infra_health_logs` por este m\u00f3dulo:\n\n| Event Type | Trigger | Severity | Payload |\n|------------|---------|----------|---------|\n| `viralmind_fn_failure` | `canvas-execute` ou `fetch-trends` falha ap\u00f3s esgotar retries / provider error | error | `{fn_name, error_message, user_id, project_id?}` |\n| `viralmind_embed_failure` | Inser\u00e7\u00e3o de n\u00f3 `mcorch_nodes` VIRALmind sem embedding ap\u00f3s timeout | warn | `{node_id, node_type, retry_count}` |\n| `viralmind_sla_breach` | Processo excede o SLA definido em \u00a76 | warn | `{process_id, elapsed_ms, threshold_ms}` |\n| `viralmind_trend_mining_stale` | `fetch-trends` cai para cache com idade > 24h | warn | `{platform, niche, cache_age_h}` |\n| `viralmind_execution_orphaned` | Execu\u00e7\u00e3o marcada `failed` pela reconcilia\u00e7\u00e3o SOL-005 | info | `{execution_id, project_id, stuck_minutes}` |\n| `viralmind_bucket_public_warning` | Auditoria detecta `canvas-assets` ainda p\u00fablico (FMEA-VM-003 n\u00e3o resolvido) | warn | `{bucket, asset_count}` |\n\n### 5.2 Auto-Recovery Script Stubs\n\n```bash\n#!/bin/bash\n# scripts/self-heal-viralmind.sh\n# Triggered by mega-brain-daemon when viralmind_fn_failure detected\n\nFUNCTION_NAME=\"$1\"   # canvas-execute | fetch-trends\nLOG_TABLE=\"infra_health_logs\"\n\necho \"[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] Self-heal triggered for $FUNCTION_NAME\"\n\n# Step 1: Health probe\nSTATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" \\\n  \"$SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/$FUNCTION_NAME\" \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY\" -X OPTIONS)\n\nif [ \"$STATUS\" != \"200\" ]; then\n  echo \"[WARN] Function unhealthy (status: $STATUS). Re-deploying...\"\n  npx supabase functions deploy \"$FUNCTION_NAME\"\n\n  # Step 2: Verify post-deploy\n  sleep 5\n  STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" \\\n    \"$SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/$FUNCTION_NAME\" -X OPTIONS)\n  [ \"$STATUS\" = \"200\" ] && echo \"[OK] Self-heal successful.\" \\\n    || echo \"[CRITICAL] Re-deploy did not heal. Escalating to Sovereign.\"\nfi\n\n# Step 3: Reconcile orphaned executions (SOL-005)\n# UPDATE vm_canvas_executions SET status='failed',\n#   error_message='timeout reconciliation'\n# WHERE status='running' AND started_at < now() - interval '5 minutes';\n```\n\n### 5.3 mega-brain-daemon Integration Points\n\n| Daemon Event | Condition | Action |\n|-------------|-----------|--------|\n| `health_check` | A cada 5 min (watchdog cron existente) | Probe `OPTIONS` em `canvas-execute` e `fetch-trends`; verificar contagem de `vm_canvas_executions` presas em `running` |\n| `anomaly_detected` | `viralmind_fn_failure` error rate > 5/hora | Executar `self-heal-viralmind.sh <fn_name>` |\n| `recovery_confirmed` | Health probe passa ap\u00f3s self-heal | Inserir evento `recovery_ok` em `infra_health_logs` |\n| `sustained_degradation` | KPI-002 ou KPI-003 em n\u00edvel cr\u00edtico por > 1h | Notificar Sovereign |\n\n---\n\n## 6. git diff HEAD | grep -E "(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{20,}|STRIPE_|SECRET_KEY|ACCESS_TOKEN|api_key\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{10,})" \

# 1d. RLS bypass risk — check for supabase.rpc calls without auth context

# 1e. Sensitive data in console.log

  | head -10 || echo "NO SENSITIVE LOGS ✅"

### DOCUMENTATION CREDENTIAL RULE (invariant — never violate)

**When writing HANDOFF.md, README.md, or any committed documentation:**

- ✅ DO: describe WHERE a credential is stored → `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY` is set in `.env` (local) and `GEMINI_API_KEY` in the Supabase vault
- ✅ DO: reference digest/fingerprint if useful → `GEMINI_API_KEY (digest 0fe0e159...)`
- 🔴 NEVER: include the actual credential value → `AIzaSyBv...`, `sk-...`, `eyJ...`

> **Rationale:** Phase 1 scans changes that predate the HANDOFF.md write. Any credential embedded
> in HANDOFF.md during Phase 4 escapes Phase 1 entirely and goes directly to the remote.
> This rule is the primary prevention layer; Phase 4b is the detection backstop.

- Body: one paragraph explaining the WHY (milestone orientation, not diff description)
- **NEVER** add `Co-Authored-By` trailer
- **NEVER** use `git add -A` — stage files explicitly by name
- Skip: `build_log.txt`, `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `.env`, `check_types.ts`, `scratch/`

Stage and commit each logical group before moving to the next phase.

## PHASE 4b — HANDOFF.md SECRET SCAN (mandatory before commit)

**Run this scan on the HANDOFF.md content about to be committed. Block if any finding exists.**

```bash
# 4b-1. Scan HANDOFF.md for real credential values
grep -nE "(AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{40,}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|xox[baprs]-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+|[a-zA-Z0-9]{32,}=\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9+/]{40,})" HANDOFF.md \
  | grep -v "example\|placeholder\|<.*>\|your-key\|YOUR_\|digest\|sha256\|hash\|fingerprint" \
  | head -20 || echo "HANDOFF.md: NO CREDENTIALS FOUND ✅"

# 4b-2. Specifically check for Google API keys (AIza prefix = 39 chars total)
grep -n "AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]\{35\}" HANDOFF.md | head -10 || echo "NO GOOGLE API KEYS ✅"

# 4b-3. Check for any = "value" pattern that looks like a real assignment
grep -nE "=\s*['\"][A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}['\"]" HANDOFF.md \
  | grep -v "example\|placeholder\|<.*>\|your-\|YOUR_\|digest\|hash\|uuid\|id.*[0-9a-f-]\{36\}" \
  | head -10 || echo "NO INLINE ASSIGNMENTS ✅"
```

**If any check returns a match:**
1. 🔴 **DO NOT COMMIT** HANDOFF.md
2. Rewrite the offending section — replace the actual value with its location description
3. Re-run Phase 4b until all checks pass
4. Only then proceed to commit HANDOFF.md

Commit HANDOFF.md only after Phase 4b passes:
```
docs(handoff): seal <phase name> — <one-line summary>
```

## PHASE 5b — BoK SEAL STATUS (v3 — mandatory before push)

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 5b-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 5b-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print this"/"session:}' | sort -u)
echo "Session touched modules: $session_new_modules"

# 5b-3. Mesh seal nodes for sealed BoK suites
source .env 2>/dev/null
if [ -n "$SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s "$SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?node_type=eq.documentation_suite&select=id,name,stability_score,created_at" \
    -H "apikey: $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"  🌐 {n['name']} ({n['stability_score']})\") for n in d]" 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "  ⚠️ Could not query seal nodes"
fi
```

**Gate verdict:**
- ✅ All session modules have sealed BoK → proceed to Phase 6 push.
- ⚠️ Module work without BoK (e.g. `feat:` commit creating new page/edge fn without `docs/bok/<slug>/`)
  → 🔴 **BLOCK seal**. Run `/bok-scribe <module>` first OR add module to exemption list (typo/dep bump/single-file patch).

Report BoK status in final seal output (Phase 7).

> 51	## 🎯 Overview
> 52	
> 53	**Constellation Orchestra** is a SaaS platform that transforms simple topics into fully monetized, multi-platform marketing campaigns. It acts as a **Harness** — a sovereign control mesh that orchestrates AI content generation, affiliate monetization (Mercado Livre), social media publishing, SEO optimization, real-time ROI tracking, and a conversational AIOS (Autonomous Intelligence Operating System).
> 54	
> 55	### Core Value Proposition
> 56	
> 57	```
> 58	1 Topic → 1 SEO Article (WordPress) + 1 B2B Post (LinkedIn) + 1 Thread (X/Twitter)
> 59	         + Affiliate Links (Mercado Livre) with per-campaign UTM attribution
> 60	         + handle-ml-postback → revenue_cents updated on every ML conversion
> 61	         + ROI Dashboard with real BRL revenue
> 62	         + GraphRAG Knowledge Node (observation inserted per run)
> 63	         + Neural HUD telemetry
> 64	         + Constellation Matrix WebGL (2095 nodes · 2543 edges — paginação completa)
> 65	         + Visual Orchestration Canvas with Quality Gates
> 66	         + AIOS — conversational AI consciousness with VAD + Barge-in
> 67	```

> 296	### Design Patterns
> 297	
> 298	- **Harness Engineering (HE):** Strict separation of visual interface and operational intelligence via custom hooks
> 299	- **Single Responsibility Principle (SRP):** No monolithic files; every module has one job
> 300	- **Exponential Backoff + Idempotency:** All external API calls are retry-safe
> 301	- **Fallback-First:** If affiliate API fails → publish with organic link; never break the pipeline
> 302	- **Hybrid Canvas State:** ReactFlow owns positions → debounced localStorage; Zustand owns run state → synced via `useEffect`
> 303	- **Tri-Mode AI:** AIOS routes to Gemini direct → OpenRouter → edge-function proxy, in that priority order

> 469	### Delta v4 — Two-Pass Cross-File Call Resolution
> 470	
> 471	```
> 472	Pass 1: visitFile(file) → nodes + intra-file CALLS edges
> 473	Post-pass: globalFunctionMap = Map<name, nodeId>
> 474	Pass 2: visitFileForCrossFileCalls → re-parses AST, walks CallExpression
> 475	  → emits CALLS edge only if callee NOT in local map BUT IN global map
> 476	  → dedup via edgeId hash
> 477	Result: +259 cross-file CALLS · 646 total edges
> 478	```

> 557	- **ML conversion nodes** auto-inserted by `handle-ml-postback` on every approved order
> 558	- `revenue_impact` tracks economic weight per node
> 559	- FSRS-6 decay active on `stability_score`
> 560	- HNSW cosine index operational

> 563	
> 564	## 🪙 mcoCoins Economics
> 565	
> 566	All paid operations are gated by an atomic RPC — no client-side deduction possible:
> 567	
> 568	```
> 569	profiles.mco_balance          → canonical billing ledger
> 570	deduct_mco_coins(user, amt)   → atomic RPC (SECURITY DEFINER, enforces balance check)
> 571	src/lib/billing.ts → COIN_COSTS
> 572	  orchestrate-content: 10 mcoCoins/run → HTTP 402 on insufficient balance
> 573	```
> 574	
> 575	| Plan | mcoCoins |
> 576	|------|----------|
> 577	| Starter | 500 |
> 578	| Pro | 2000 |
> 579	| Enterprise | 10000 |
> 580	
> 581	| Operation | Cost |
> 582	|-----------|------|
> 583	| Orchestration run | 10 mcoCoins |
> 584	| Content generation | 5 mcoCoins |
> 585	| Image generation | 3 mcoCoins |
> 586	| Node embedding | 1 mcoCoin |
> 587	
> 588	### Self-Service Top-Up
> 589	
> 590	`/dashboard/settings` → card **"mcoCoins — Saldo Soberano"**:
> 591	- Saldo em tempo real (`profiles.mco_balance`)
> 592	- Input livre + atalhos rápidos **+500 / +2000 / +10000**
> 593	- Update atômico client-side (RLS garante owner-only write)
> 594	- Histórico de acúmulo via n8n autonomic-action (+10pts/run)
> 595	
> 596	The balance is shown in real-time in the Dashboard header via Supabase Realtime subscription.

> 792	
> 793	| Table | Purpose | RLS |
> 794	|-------|---------|-----|
> 795	| `mcorch_nodes` | GraphRAG nodes — `embedding vector(768)`, `stability_score`, `revenue_impact` | `user_id IS NULL OR auth.uid() = user_id` |
> 796	| `mcorch_edges` | Relationships (DEFINES, CALLS, etc.) | Same |
> 797	| `system_milestones` | Phase boundary events | Read all authenticated |
> 798	| `infra_health_logs` | Watchdog telemetry | Read all authenticated; write service_role |
> 799	
> 800	### Security Model
> 801	
> 802	- **RLS on ALL tables** — default deny
> 803	- **Column-level restrictions** on `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `stripe_*`
> 804	- **Private storage buckets** — served via short-lived signed URLs
> 805	- **RESTRICTIVE policies** for financial/affiliate data (no client delete)
> 806	- **Multi-tenant:** `mcorch_nodes` isolated by `user_id + project_id`
> 807	- **`has_role()` SECURITY DEFINER** — recursive-safe admin checks

> 920	## 🚀 Getting Started
> 921	
> 922	### Prerequisites
> 923	
> 924	- Bun (preferred) or Node.js 18+
> 925	- Supabase project
> 926	- Docker (for Sovereign Mesh containers)
> 927	
> 928	### Installation
> 929	
> 930	```bash
> 931	git clone git@github.com:gabrielZarattini/constellation-orchestra.git
> 932	cd constellation-orchestra
> 933	bun install
> 934	bun dev
> 935	```
> 936	
> 937	### Production Build & Deploy
> 938	
> 939	This project is served as static files from `dist/` via nginx (CloudPanel). After every code change:
> 940	
> 941	```bash
> 942	# 1. Rebuild static assets
> 943	bun run build
> 944	
> 945	# 2. Deploy changed edge functions
> 946	npx supabase functions deploy orchestrate-content
> 947	npx supabase functions deploy handle-ml-postback
> 948	# (or specific function that changed)
> 949	
> 950	# 3. Apply new migrations (if any)
> 951	npx supabase db push
> 952	
> 953	# nginx serves dist/ automatically — no restart needed
> 954	```
> 955	
> 956	### GitNexus MCP (Claude Code)
> 957	
> 958	```bash
> 959	cd packages/gitnexus-core && npm run build
> 960	# .mcp.json wires it automatically via stdio
> 961	npm run sync-mesh   # sync AST to Supabase Knowledge Mesh
> 962	```
> 963	
> 964	### Knowledge Mesh — Comandos Essenciais
> 965	
> 966	```bash
> 967	# ── Backfill de código-fonte nos nós AST ─────────────────────────────
> 968	bun run scripts/backfill-node-content.ts
> 969	# Popula mcorch_nodes.content com código real via metadata.location
> 970	# Precisa de .env com SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
> 971	# Resultado: ~1758 updated · ~200 skipped (sem metadata.location) · 0 errors
> 972	
> 973	# ── Backfill de embeddings (Bun-native) ──────────────────────────────
> 974	bun run scripts/backfill-embeddings.ts
> 975	# Embeda todos os nós com embedding IS NULL em batches de 10
> 976	# Progress: ✅ N/total embedded — last: <nome do nó>
> 977	# Idempotente: segunda execução → "Found 0 nodes without embeddings"
> 978	
> 979	# ── Re-ingesta do AST no Knowledge Mesh ─────────────────────────────
> 980	node scripts/ingest-codebase.ts              # foreground com log
> 981	node scripts/ingest-codebase.ts --quiet      # background (usado pelo post-commit hook)
> 982	# Ou direto:
> 983	cd packages/gitnexus-core && npm run sync-mesh
> 984	
> 985	# ── Deploy das edge functions nucleares ──────────────────────────────
> 986	npx supabase functions deploy embed-mcorch-node    # embeddings (nuclear)
> 987	npx supabase functions deploy analyze-node         # AI Brain da Matrix
> 988	npx supabase functions deploy trigger-embeddings   # batch sync via UI
> 989	npx supabase functions deploy trigger-ingest       # mesh stats via UI
> 990	
> 991	# ── Verificar saúde do pipeline de embedding ─────────────────────────
> 992	curl -s "https://bcyvddsykvehvpwstlfa.supabase.co/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?embedding=is.null&select=id,name" \
> 993	  -H "apikey: $SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" \
> 994	  | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'{len(d)} nós sem embedding')"
> 995	# Resultado esperado: "0 nós sem embedding"
> 996	
> 997	# ── Log do post-commit hook ───────────────────────────────────────────
> 998	tail -f /tmp/mcorch-ingest.log
> 999	# Acompanha re-ingesta do AST em background após cada git commit
> 1000	
> 1001	# ── Aplicar novas migrations ─────────────────────────────────────────
> 1002	npx supabase db push
> 1003	
> 1004	# ── Verificar triggers ativos na mesh ────────────────────────────────
> 1005	# Via psql ou Supabase Studio:
> 1006	# SELECT tgname, tgenabled FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'mcorch_nodes'::regclass;
> 1007	# Esperado: trg_mcorch_embed_on_insert — enabled
> 1008	```
> 1009

> 1114	## 🤝 Agent Protocol (ShakeHands)
> 1115	
> 1116	This repository uses a **ShakeHands Continuity Protocol** for AI agent session management. Every session starts with `/handson` and ends with `/handoff`.
> 1117	
> 1118	```
> 1119	/handson  → reads HANDOFF.md + memory index + git log + container health
> 1120	            → produces session brief in < 10 seconds
> 1121	/handoff  → granular commits by concern → updates HANDOFF.md → git push origin main
> 1122	            → bun run build for local production deploy
> 1123	```
> 1124	
> 1125	**Memory system:** `/home/ubuntu/.claude/projects/…/memory/` — persistent across sessions, covering user profile, project state, feedback, and references. MEMORY.md is the index.
> 1126	
> 1127	**GitNexus MCP** is automatically available in Claude Code via `.mcp.json` (stdio, no Docker required).

> 1131	## 🤝 Contributing
> 1132	
> 1133	### Code Standards
> 1134	
> 1135	- **Language:** Code, variables, comments, logs → **English**
> 1136	- **UI:** Interface, toasts, validation → **Portuguese (Brazil)**
> 1137	- **TypeScript:** Strict; explicit types everywhere
> 1138	- **Architecture:** Harness Engineering — hooks for logic, components for display
> 1139	- **Naming:** `PascalCase` (components/interfaces) · `camelCase` (functions/vars) · `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` (constants)
> 1140	
> 1141	### Commit Convention
> 1142	
> 1143	```
> 1144	feat:          new feature
> 1145	fix:           bug fix
> 1146	feat(edge):    edge function
> 1147	feat(hooks):   custom hook
> 1148	feat(ui):      component or page
> 1149	refactor:      code restructuring
> 1150	chore:         tooling, dependencies
> 1151	docs:          documentation (including HANDOFF.md seals)
> 1152	```

Let me think about this carefully:

The issue is about the **timing** of when the node count badge is captured vs when nodes are actually inserted during the handoff process. This is a sequencing issue in the `/handoff` protocol itself.

The `/handoff` protocol (Phase 3 = README update, Phase 5 = Knowledge Mesh milestone node insertion) has an inherent race condition:
- Phase 3: Queries live node count → updates README badge


- Phase 5: Inserts the handoff milestone node into mcorch_nodes
- Phase 6: Commits and pushes (which triggers post-commit hooks like AST ingest)

So by design, the badge in README.md will always be **at least 1 node behind** because the count is captured before the milestone node gets inserted, and then the post-commit AST ingest hook adds even more nodes after everything's committed. This is a structural issue baked into the handoff protocol itself—the question is whether it's worth fixing or if it's acceptable as-is.

The user is asking if this is expected or a bug. It's actually both: the lag is expected given how the phases are sequenced (the count query happens before the milestone insertion), but it could be fixed by reordering things—insert the milestone first, then query and update the badge. Every handoff should increase the node count since we're always adding at least the milestone node itself, plus whatever the AST ingest hook picks up from code changes. So the behavior is partially expected due to protocol timing, but the real fix would require restructuring when these operations happen.

</details>
